title: Credit Repair
description:

Review and analyze client credit reports

Ability to meet deadlines and work independently

Your previous experience with credit repair or disputes

Only applicants with relevant experience in credit repair or dispute processing will be considered.

title: Video Editor: AI Ads That Actually Sell (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
If you're a good editor, you already know what most editing jobs look like.



You get a brief. You cut it. You send it. You never find out if it worked.



And a year later, you're the same editor you were when you started.



This isn't that job.



We're North Star Brands. We build e-commerce brands in health and wellness, and we're about to grow faster than we ever have.



Which means there's room for a few good editors to grow with us. Into a bigger role, better work, and better pay.



HOW WE WORK



Here, every cut has a reason.



We care about why a clip is there, what it makes the viewer feel, and what it gets them to believe. If you can't say why a shot is in the ad, it probably shouldn't be.



And we want that at speed. High quality, and a lot of it.



WHAT YOU GET



• Real growth. Three months in, we want you to look back at the editor you were and barely recognise them.

• A path you can earn. Editor, then lead editor, then creative strategist, if you put the work in.

• You'll be ahead of AI, not replaced by it. AI is changing this job fast. We're bringing agentic video editing (editing with AI agents like Claude) into how we work. We're learning it as a team, and we'll train every editor on it.

• You'll see your results. You get the numbers on every ad you edit, we teach you how to read them, and you get paid when your ads win.

• You'll learn the strategy, not just the edit. Every week the team goes through what won, what lost, and why.

• We invest in your growth. Courses, resources, the best workflows out there: if it makes you better, we'll get it for you. We're plugged into the best e-com programs and people.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT



• Mostly AI ads: AI movie dramas and AI animations.

• VSLs and talking-to-camera story ads.

• Some motion graphics, so you need to know After Effects, or at least be comfortable in it.



Briefs come from our creative strategists. There's enough work to fill a full 8-hour day, and we track both speed and quality.



YOU'RE WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR IF



• You've edited direct-response ads, and you know the edit's job is to sell.

• You have taste. You know when a shot holds too long or the music is wrong, without being told.

• You think about the marketing, not just the timeline.

• You're hungry and humble. You take feedback once and don't need it twice.

• You do the right thing without being told, like finding a faster way to work and sharing it with the team.

• You want to build something big, and grow into a bigger role while you do it.

• You want one company to go all in on.



THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF



• You're juggling other clients. This is full-time and exclusive: one company, nothing on the side.

• You want a calm, easy 9-to-5.

• You want to cut what you're sent and log off.

• You're here for the paycheck until something better comes along.

• You're just starting out. We're not teaching editing from scratch.



PAY



• $2,000 to $2,500 USD a month. Full-time and exclusive, 5 days a week, fully remote.

• Plus performance bonuses on the ads that win. $200 to $500 for every winning ad that hits its KPI. No cap: the more winning ads you make, the more you earn.



If you've read this far, the keyword is "Straight Spine". The form will ask for it.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here (about 10 minutes):





Have these ready:



1. Your portfolio: 3 to 5 direct-response ads. Make sure the links open without us requesting access.

2. A 3 to 5 minute Loom, camera on, made for this job. It's a mini interview: the form tells you exactly what to cover, including three questions you answer out loud. READ IT CAREFULLY. Looms that skip anything aren't reviewed.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review every application.

2. A short trial edit.

3. A call.



We reply by
, so check your spam folder. If you hear from us, reply within 24 hours.



P.S. If you read all of this and felt like it was written for you, it probably was. Apply today. We move fast.

- 3 to 5 years of dropshipping experience.

- Experience working with large warehouses in the UAE, the Gulf, China, or East Asia.

- Strong, long-standing relationships with warehouses in this field.

1. Research winning products and analyze demand, competitors, and pricing.

title: Meta Ads, Google Ads & Social Media Expert (E-commerce Sales, Oman)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

I run two e-commerce stores in Oman, Boothat and Ardor, selling personal-care and wellness products. Some of these products are sensitive under Meta and Google advertising policies. I need one person who owns paid advertising and turns it into real sales, not just clicks. This is a long-term role for someone who can work independently.



PRIORITY RESPONSIBILITIES (in order)

1. Own Meta Ads 
 + Instagram) for both stores: plan, launch, test, and scale campaigns for sales (purchases), not traffic.

2. Keep ad accounts safe and approved. Write compliant ad copy, creatives, and landing-page wording for sensitive categories, and handle policy rejections and appeals.

3. Set up and verify tracking (Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google tag/GA4) on a local Omani store platform (not Shopify), and confirm purchases are measured correctly before spending.

4. Run Google Ads (Search and Shopping/Merchant Center where policy allows) for high-intent buyers in Oman.

5. Build the creative testing plan: angles, hooks, and offers, and brief my designer. Tailor creatives to Oman (Arabic/English, Instagram-first behavior).

6. Manage budgets by profit, not just platform ROAS: ad spend must stay inside product margin, and selling prices cannot exceed market prices in Oman. Flag products where ads are not profitable.

7. Use offers that fit our delivery rules (delivery fee inside vs outside Muscat, free-delivery threshold) in ad messaging and retargeting.

8. Set up retargeting (cart abandoners, product viewers, past buyers).

9. Support Instagram content: weekly content ideas, captions, and hashtags aligned with the ads.

10. Report weekly: spend, purchases, revenue, ROAS, cost per purchase, and what you will stop, change, or scale next.



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven e-commerce product-sales results on Meta (not only lead generation).

- Hands-on experience with restricted or sensitive ad categories (health, personal care, wellness) and policy appeals.

- Pixel + Conversions API experience on non-Shopify stores.

- Google Ads experience (Search, Shopping, PMax) is a strong plus.

- Advanced English. Arabic is a bonus.

- Able to overlap with Oman business hours (GMT+4).



TOOLS

Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Merchant Center, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Canva or CapCut, Google Sheets.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

- Purchases and revenue from ads, and ROAS above break-even after delivery and product cost.

- Ad account health (low rejection rate, no account bans).

- Correct tracking: ad-reported purchases match store orders.

- Clear weekly reports with decisions, not just numbers.



WHAT TO INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION MESSAGE

1. 2-3 e-commerce case studies: ad spend, revenue, ROAS, period, and business type. Screenshots from Ads Manager are welcome (client names can be hidden).

2. The largest monthly Meta budget you have managed.

3. Your experience with sensitive categories and how you handled ad rejections.

4. How you would set up Pixel + Conversions API on a non-Shopify store.

5. Your availability.

description:
About the role

We run an AI-generated influencer accounts and need a detail-oriented assistant to find and review short-form reference videos (Instagram Reels and TikTok). The content is lifestyle, fashion, glamour and suggestive, so applicants must be 18+ and comfortable reviewing adult-oriented (non-explicit) social media content.



What you'll do



 • Find new creators across set niches (fashion, fitness, dance, lifestyle, glamour and more) using Instagram's search, audio pages and "similar accounts" features.

 • Verify every creator is 18+ before adding them, and record how you checked (age in bio, ID-verified platform link, etc.). No verification means the creator isn't added.

 • Review a weekly list of reels in Google Sheets and mark each one Approve or Reject using our checklist.

 • Add short notes on why a reel works, such as its format, hook or trending audio.



Weekly targets



 • 50-100 approved reels

 • 5–10 new verified creators added to the Seeds tab



Checklist we'll train you on



 • one person on screen, face clearly visible

 • fitted clothing, steady camera, full or half body in frame

 • under 15 seconds, strong views compared with the creator's follower count



Requirements



 • 18+

 • strong English and attention to detail

 • experienced with Instagram and TikTok, and with Google Sheets

 • reliable internet and a smartphone or laptop

 • bonus: experience in social media research, influencer marketing or content curation



Hours and pay



 • about 8–10 hours a week, flexible schedule

 • [$4–6 USD/hr, or a fixed weekly rate of $___]

 • paid weekly, with room for more hours and a raise as we grow



How to apply



 1. Start your application with the word "REELS" so we know you read the post.

 2. Tell us about any social media research or curation work you've done.

 3. Send 3 Instagram Reels from creators with under 300k followers that got far more views than their follower count, and say in one line why each worked.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid 1-hour trial task.

title: B2B Sales & Customer Acquisition Specialist
description:
B2B Sales & Customer Acquisition Specialist (Part-Time, Remote)



About Us



Archive Duplication Company is a U.S.-based printing, custom apparel, signage, and business branding company serving businesses, organizations, contractors, churches, and entrepreneurs.



We are expanding our sales operations and are looking for a motivated, experienced B2B Sales & Customer Acquisition Specialist who can help us generate leads, manage customer inquiries, prepare quotes, and turn opportunities into paying customers.



We also operate Faith Walkers General Contracting, a construction and property improvement company. As the role develops, you may assist with lead qualification and appointment scheduling for that business.



Your Responsibilities



Research and identify potential business customers.



Manage new inquiries and follow up with existing customers.



Conduct personalized B2B sales outreach through approved channels.



Prepare quotes using our established pricing guidelines.



Follow up with prospects and help close sales.



Maintain accurate customer records and follow-up schedules in Google Sheets and CRM systems.



Coordinate customer requirements with our production team and vendors.



Provide daily activity updates and weekly sales performance reports.



What We're Looking For



Previous B2B sales, lead generation, or appointment-setting experience.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Experience communicating professionally with U.S. business customers.



Strong customer service and follow-up skills.



Ability to work independently and meet measurable goals.



Proficiency with Google Sheets, Gmail, and CRM systems.



Confidence discussing pricing, answering objections, and asking customers for the sale.



Reliable internet, a computer, and availability for scheduled U.S. Central Time business hours.



Experience with printing, promotional products, apparel, signs, or construction-related sales is a plus.



Schedule and Compensation



Part-time: 15 hours per week.



Starting compensation: $7 USD per hour.



Defined hours overlapping U.S. Central Time business hours.



Paid training and a performance-based evaluation period.



Potential for performance incentives and increased hours based on results.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Describe your previous experience generating and closing B2B sales.



What sales results have you personally achieved? Please provide specific examples.



How would you approach a U.S. contractor who may need company uniforms, vehicle lettering, or jobsite signage?



What CRM systems or sales tracking tools have you used?



Are you comfortable preparing quotations using a company pricebook?



Can you work 15 hours per week with scheduled overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours?



Practical Exercise



Briefly write a follow-up
 to a business customer who received a quote for company shirts five days ago but has not responded.



We are seeking someone interested in growing with a company, taking ownership of results, and potentially developing into a sales leadership position.

title: Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator
description:
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM PST (Tuesday–Saturday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time), with a 1 hour break

Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote Position



A new and growing United States-based, Medicare-certified home health agency, operational for less than one year, is seeking an experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator.



A clinical background is required for this position.



The ideal candidate will have experience reviewing clinical documentation for a United States-based home health agency and be familiar with the Medicare Conditions of Participation, home health regulatory requirements, and CHAP accreditation standards.



The selected candidate will support the agency’s Quality Assurance and compliance program by reviewing clinical records, identifying documentation deficiencies, monitoring required corrections, and helping ensure that patient records meet Medicare, regulatory, accreditation, and agency standards.



We are seeking a dependable professional who can communicate respectfully with clinicians, manage multiple priorities, and support the agency's commitment to quality patient care, regulatory compliance, and survey readiness.



Required Qualifications

•	Clinical background required.

•	Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

•	Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-up, and time management.

•	Ability to identify inconsistencies in assessments, physician orders, plans of care, and clinical documentation.

•	Ability to address documentation concerns professionally and respectfully.

•	Strong multitasking skills and ability to manage competing priorities.

•	Proficiency with EMRs,
, spreadsheets, virtual meeting platforms, and document management systems.

•	Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to leadership.

•	Reliable computer, secure high-speed internet, quiet workspace, backup internet, and backup power source.

•	Full-time availability during California Pacific Time business hours.



Preferred Experience

•	Experience with a U.S.-based Medicare-certified home health agency.

•	Knowledge of Medicare Conditions of Participation and home health regulations.

•	Experience with CHAP accreditation standards and survey preparation.

•	Background in Quality Assurance, clinical documentation review, compliance, utilization review, case management, or chart auditing.

•	Familiarity with OASIS, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, homebound status, and skilled-need requirements.

•	Experience reviewing nursing, therapy, and interdisciplinary clinical documentation.

•	Experience with pre-billing chart reviews and documentation correction tracking.

•	Knowledge of survey readiness, audit preparation, and performance improvement.

•	Experience with ADRs, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.



Primary Responsibilities

•	Review home health records for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely submission.

•	Review OASIS assessments, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, medication profiles, assessments, and visit notes.

•	Validate documentation supporting skilled need, homebound status, diagnoses, ordered services, and the plan of care.

•	Identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, vague, late, or noncompliant documentation.

•	Ensure compliance with Medicare regulations, agency policies, and accreditation standards.

•	Communicate documentation corrections clearly and professionally.

•	Track outstanding corrections and follow through to completion.

•	Verify corrected documents are properly completed, dated, and signed.

•	Assist with pre-billing reviews, chart audits, compliance monitoring, quality reporting, and performance improvement activities.

•	Maintain QA logs, audit tools, correction trackers, and pending-documentation reports.

•	Support preparation for CHAP surveys, Medicare reviews, and regulatory audits.

•	Identify recurring documentation issues and recommend educational opportunities for clinicians.

•	Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality.

•	Participate in virtual meetings, training, quality initiatives, and workflow improvement efforts.



Applicants with strong clinical and home health backgrounds may be considered if they demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn Medicare and CHAP requirements.



Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate will be:

•	Experienced in U.S. home health Quality Assurance.

•	Knowledgeable about Medicare home health documentation and compliance requirements.

•	Familiar with OASIS, plans of care, physician orders, and clinical documentation.

•	Experienced with ADRs, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.

•	Able to provide clear, accurate, and respectful feedback.

•	Organized, dependable, and deadline-oriented.

•	Proactive in identifying and resolving documentation risks.

•	Comfortable communicating with clinicians, physicians, office staff, and leadership.

•	Interested in helping a growing agency build strong Quality Assurance processes.



Compensation and Benefits

•	Starting compensation: $10.00 USD per hour.

•	Three paid holidays annually, subject to approval and staffing coverage.

•	December bonus equivalent to one month of base compensation, subject to performance and company policy.

•	Paid vacation eligibility after one year of service.

•	Compensation review after one year based on performance, attendance, reliability, expanded responsibilities, and company financial performance.

•	Training and professional growth opportunities as the agency expands.



How to Apply

Please submit the following to 

•	Current résumé.

•	Brief summary of clinical background.

•	Summary of U.S. home health experience.

•	Experience with Quality Assurance, chart review, OASIS, clinical documentation, or regulatory compliance.

•	Experience with Medicare Conditions of Participation and/or accreditation standards.

•	List of home health EMR systems used.

•	Confirmation of availability during California Pacific Time business hours.

•	Information regarding computer, internet connection, backup internet, and backup power source.

•	Brief explanation of why you are a strong candidate for this position.



Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in a virtual interview and complete a brief Quality Assurance or clinical documentation assessment.



We are committed to building a professional, collaborative, and supportive team that values clinical accuracy, accountability, compliance, respectful communication, teamwork, and excellent patient care.



Compensation, benefits, work schedule, employment classification, bonus eligibility, and other terms will be confirmed in the final written agreement and administered in accordance with company policy and applicable requirements.

title: Social Media Manager & Digital Marketing VA
description:
# NOW HIRING: Social Media Manager & Digital Marketing VA

**Real Estate | Meta Ads | YouTube SEO | Reels & Video Editing**



**Company:** Davis Capital Realty  

**Location:** Remote / International Applicants Welcome  

**Position:** Part-Time, Long-Term Opportunity  

**Compensation:** $5–$9 USD/hour, based on experience and demonstrated skills  

**Schedule:** Initially 10–15 hours per week, with potential to expand



### About Our Company



Davis Capital Realty is an established real estate brokerage based in Los Angeles, California. We are looking for a creative, organized, tech-savvy Social Media Manager and Digital Marketing Virtual Assistant to help expand our online presence, strengthen our brand, and generate new business opportunities.



Our goal is to establish Davis Capital Realty and its Broker/Owner, Ruben Davis, as a trusted, recognizable authority in the Southern California real estate market.



We already have professionally designed marketing materials, video campaigns, graphics, and content ready to publish. We need someone who knows how to turn those assets into a consistent, engaging, results-driven online marketing presence.



This is not simply a graphic design position. We are looking for someone who understands social media marketing, content distribution, SEO, paid advertising, and audience engagement.



### Primary Responsibilities



**1. Social Media Management & Publishing**



- Manage content across
, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Upload, schedule, and publish provided marketing materials.

- Write compelling, natural, professional captions and calls to action.

- Adapt content for each platform rather than posting identical copy everywhere.

- Research relevant hashtags, keywords, and audience interests.

- Maintain a consistent posting calendar.

- Monitor comments, engagement, and incoming inquiries.

- Help develop strategies to increase followers, visibility, and qualified leads.



**2. Meta Ads Manager — REQUIRED**



- Demonstrate experience with Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager.

- Set up and manage
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Understand campaign objectives, audience targeting, geographic targeting, placements, and budgets.

- Configure lead generation, engagement, and video campaigns.

- Conduct A/B testing and optimize campaigns based on performance.

- Understand Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, and lead forms.

- Provide performance reports with recommendations for improvement.

- Experience with real estate advertising and Meta's Housing Special Ad Category is strongly preferred.



**3. YouTube Management & SEO**



- Upload and optimize YouTube videos.

- Write SEO-focused titles, descriptions, and video metadata.

- Upload and test video thumbnails.

- Organize videos into playlists.

- Create YouTube Shorts from existing videos.

- Improve channel branding and discoverability.

- Use analytics to identify opportunities for increased viewership and engagement.



**4. Short-Form Video Editing**



- Edit short videos, Instagram Reels, TikToks,
 Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Stories.

- Add professional captions, subtitles, transitions, and appropriate background music.

- Repurpose longer videos into shorter, engaging clips.

- Use tools such as CapCut, Canva Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.

- Maintain consistent branding and a polished, professional appearance.



**5. Search Engine Optimization & Online Visibility**



- Optimize social media profiles and YouTube content for search visibility.

- Assist with Google Business Profile updates and posts.

- Research local real estate keywords relevant to Los Angeles and surrounding communities.

- Recommend improvements to online branding, content strategy, and discoverability.

- Help strengthen the company's digital footprint through consistent content and relevant local SEO practices.



### Immediate Project: Seven-Week Real Estate Marketing Campaign



We have a complete seven-week real estate video marketing campaign ready for execution.



Each week, we will provide professionally prepared video content, graphics, thumbnails, captions, and episode instructions.



Your responsibilities will include:



1. Uploading and optimizing one weekly YouTube episode.

2. Setting up YouTube thumbnail A/B testing where available.

3. Scheduling two
 and Instagram static posts per week.

4. Uploading native video content to
 and Instagram.

5. Optimizing content for TikTok and YouTube Shorts when appropriate.

6. Writing and refining captions, hashtags, and calls to action.

7. Connecting social media posts to our YouTube content and lead-generation channels.

8. Publishing content according to a consistent weekly schedule.

9. Checking links, formatting, branding, and post accuracy.

10. Providing a brief weekly performance report.



We want someone who can take a completed content package and execute it with minimal supervision.



### Required Qualifications



- At least two years of relevant social media management experience.

- Demonstrated experience using Meta Ads Manager.

- Strong written English and excellent attention to detail.

- Experience with
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

- Ability to edit short-form videos.

- Familiarity with Canva Pro, CapCut, and social media scheduling tools.

- Understanding of SEO, hashtags, analytics, and audience engagement.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively.



**Preferred Qualifications**



- Previous experience working with U.S. real estate companies, agents, or brokerages.

- Experience with real estate lead generation.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.

- Experience with Google Business Profile and local SEO.

- Knowledge of U.S. social media audiences and real estate marketing trends.



### What We're Looking For



We value creativity, reliability, initiative, and accountability.



We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions every day. We want someone who can follow an established marketing plan, identify opportunities for improvement, and help us build a stronger online presence.



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction describing your social media marketing experience.

2. Links to two or three social media accounts you have personally managed.

3. Examples of short-form videos or Reels you have edited.

4. A description of your experience with Meta Ads Manager, including campaign objectives and results.

5. Your experience with YouTube SEO and video optimization.

6. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

7. A brief explanation of how you would help a Los Angeles real estate brokerage increase its online visibility and generate seller leads.



**Important:** Begin your application with the words **"Davis Digital Growth"** so we know you have read the entire job description.



We are looking to establish a long-term working relationship with the right person.



**Davis Capital Realty**  

Los Angeles, California  

*Building relationships. Delivering results.*

title: REMOTE HIRING: VIRTUAL ASSISTANTS & PROJECT COORDINATORS
description:

- 6 openings

- $4-$6 USD/hour

- Part-time or full-time

- Early Dec 2026 start



Join a remote team supporting leadership and on-site staff across multiple locations. You'll take ownership of one area, track tasks from assignment through completion, and follow up on deadlines and outstanding decisions.



The hourly rate is based on experience and skills. We aim to start in 2-3 weeks. Working hours depend on the role and coverage needs.





OPEN ROLES



1. GENERAL OPERATIONS

Keep leadership priorities and daily site operations on track.

- Use Slack to coordinate staff coverage, onboarding, and handoffs across locations.

- Maintain task trackers and operating procedures. Record owners, deadlines, and next steps.

- Schedule meetings, capture decisions, and follow up on open items with staff and vendors.

- Escalate time-sensitive issues and send leadership a weekly progress report.

What you bring: Operations, executive assistance, or project coordination experience. Comfortable with Slack, Google Workspace, and shared task trackers.



2. ACCOUNTING & BOOKKEEPING

Keep financial records organized and ready for review.

- Track invoices, due dates, receivables, and expenses. Collect receipts and supporting records.

- Match sales and cash deposit records to reports. Flag discrepancies for review.

- Collect time submissions, flag missing entries, and support reconciliations and month-end close.

What you bring: Bookkeeping experience, familiarity with double-entry accounting, and strong Excel skills (lookups, formulas, pivot tables). QuickBooks or Xero is a plus.



3. SECURITY & CCTV MONITORING

Monitor live camera feeds during assigned shifts and alert the appropriate team when an issue needs attention.

- Monitor assigned feeds and report safety concerns or unusual activity promptly using the escalation procedure.

- Log the time, camera location, observations, and notifications. Save footage in approved systems when instructed.

- Check for offline feeds, review recordings when requested, and submit an end-of-shift handoff.

What you bring: A stable connection for live video, sustained attention, sound judgment, and discretion. CCTV or DVR/NVR experience is a plus.



4. SOCIAL MEDIA & MARKETING

Turn campaign priorities and approved promotions into a publishing schedule.

- Maintain a monthly content calendar and create copy, graphics, and short videos for relevant platforms.

- Coordinate approvals and asset collection with leadership and on-site teams before publishing.

- Monitor comments and messages. Report reach, engagement, and inquiries generated by campaigns.

What you bring: Experience managing social accounts, strong writing, and basic design or video editing. Familiarity with Canva and scheduling or analytics tools is a plus.



5. HEALTHCARE ADMINISTRATION

Support clinicians and leadership with scheduling and project administration.

- Coordinate meetings and telehealth logistics, confirm attendance, and follow up on administrative action items.

- Track deadlines and pending documents with authorized clinic staff, providers, and vendors.

- Handle sensitive records only as authorized, using approved systems and privacy procedures.

What you bring: Healthcare administration or related experience, familiarity with medical terminology, and careful handling of confidential information.



6. INVENTORY & PURCHASING

Maintain accurate stock records across locations and help purchasing plan reorders.

- Collect and reconcile on-site counts with receipts, transfers, and other stock movements.

- Follow up with site staff on discrepancies and document verified corrections in the tracker.

- Prepare low-stock and reorder reports. Track open purchase orders and expected deliveries.

What you bring: Inventory, purchasing, or supply chain experience, strong spreadsheet skills, and attention to quantities and units.





WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN EVERY CANDIDATE

- Clear written and spoken English, with concise Slack updates and dependable follow-through.

- A reliable computer and internet connection, and availability during agreed working hours.

- The ability to prioritize independently, raise urgent issues early, and handle confidential information with discretion.





HOW TO APPLY

Apply through the listing where you found this posting. If the platform asks for a subject line, use "Application - [Role Name]". You may apply for more than one role.



Please include:

- Your resume or CV and the role or roles you're applying for.

- Your preferred schedule (part-time or full-time), weekly availability, time zone, and earliest start date.

- Your expected hourly rate within the advertised range.

- A brief example of a relevant task or project you owned, including the tools you used and the outcome.



Applications are reviewed as they arrive. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a short interview.

title: Discord Communication Assistant
description:
Creators Corner is a community that helps TikTok Shop creators land brand deals and grow their income. We’re hiring two Discord Communication Assistants to guide new members through onboarding. You’ll be the first person they talk to after joining: welcoming them in their private onboarding ticket, checking in on their progress through the course and quiz, answering common questions and keeping them moving until they reach our job boards. This role is about consistent, friendly, organized communication. Every member should feel supported and always know their next step.



Day to day, you’ll manage your assigned tickets in Discord. That means replying within the hour to questions, sending weekly check-ins, tracking where each member is in the process, and following our SOP for inactive tickets and close-outs. You’ll also send standard answers to common questions such as course access, account setup and job board steps. When something needs another team member (payments, refunds, sample shipping or technical issues), you’ll pass it to the right person and follow up until it’s resolved. You’ll work closely with our onboarding coaches, who review member video assignments.



You’ll be a great fit if you write in a warm, upbeat tone, stay organized across dozens of conversations at once and are reliable about response times. Experience with Discord, community management or customer support is a big plus, and familiarity with TikTok or TikTok Shop is a bonus. Applicants need strong written English and some availability during US business hours. Spanish is a plus, since we have a growing Spanish-speaking community.

title: Experienced Credit Repair Virtual Assistant (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Job details: Full-time, 40 hours/week, long-term, dedicated to Consumer Rights Solutions (CRS) only — one client. Work hours: Monday–Friday, overlapping US Central business hours (9am–5pm CT = 11pm–7am Manila). Location: Remote, Philippines. Work from a dedicated Windows VPS/RDP workstation we provide. Salary: $800/month flat (full-time). Payment direct via Wise. Company: Consumer Rights Solutions (CRS) — Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA.



About us: Consumer Rights Solutions (CRS) is a US credit repair and funding company based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. We help clients dispute inaccurate items on their credit reports with the three bureaus — Equifax, Experian and TransUnion — and guide them through funding readiness. We have a fully built, proprietary disputing software platform that generates and manages disputes. We are hiring our first dedicated disputing VA to run it daily.



The role — what you will actually do: This is not a build-the-system job. The software already does the heavy lifting. Your job is to learn it, use it accurately every day, and keep client files moving:

- Learn and use our disputing software daily to dispute client files

- Input and submit disputes on our platform, via LetterStream (mail) and via the CFPB portal, exactly as generated — no invented facts, no added claims, nothing outside the client file

- Log bureau and creditor responses, track what was removed vs. still reporting, and update each client file after every round

- Monitor dispute rounds, follow up on stuck or overdue items, and flag anything unusual to the owner

- Handle customer service as we scale: reply to client messages, give progress updates, collect documents, and keep clients informed

- Keep records clean and accurate — attention to detail matters more than speed

Because the software handles most of the disputing, disputing itself should take a fraction of your day. The rest is monitoring, logging, follow-up and customer service.



What we are looking for:

- 2+ years of hands-on credit repair disputing experience (not just admin) — you know the dispute cycle end to end

- Strong working knowledge of FCRA, the three bureaus, and the CFPB complaint process

- Experience with LetterStream or similar mail/dispute tools is a big plus

- Excellent written and spoken English — you will write to US clients

- Extremely detail-oriented and reliable: you follow a process exactly, double-check before submitting, and never guess at a client's facts

- Comfortable learning new software quickly and working independently once trained

- Stable internet, quiet workspace, and able to work hours overlapping US Central time

- Long-term mindset — we want someone who becomes part of the team, not a short-term gig



What we provide:

- Full training on our software and dispute process

- A dedicated Windows VPS / RDP workstation provided by us (standard user account — you do not need your own high-end PC)

- Direct pay via Wise, on time

- A growing role: as volume grows, this becomes the disputing + customer-service lead for the team



How to apply — please apply only via OnlineJobs.ph and answer all of these in your application:

1. How many years have you worked in credit repair disputing, and for how many clients at a time?

2. Which bureaus and tools have you used (Equifax / Experian / TransUnion, CFPB, LetterStream, Metro 2, etc.)?

3. Walk through one dispute round, step by step, from receiving a client file to logging the bureau response.

4. What is your expected monthly salary for full-time work, and are you available for hours overlapping US Central time?

5. Are you currently working for another client? (We need someone dedicated to CRS.)

Applications without answers to the questions above will not be considered.

title: Intake Coordinator (Remote, Philippines)
description:
Intake & Care Coordinator (Remote, Philippines)



Company: Core Admin Solutions (headquartered in California, USA)

Type: Full-time, remote (work from home in the Philippines)

Pay: $5 USD/hour, paid bi-weekly via Wise



About the role



We’re looking for an Intake Coordinator to be the first voice patients and referral partners hear when they contact us. You’ll answer calls, gather the right information, and coordinate each new patient’s care so they get scheduled quickly and nothing falls through the cracks. This role suits someone who is warm and professional on the phone, detail-oriented, and comfortable keeping many moving pieces organized.



What you’ll do

Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally, and handle voi
s and call-backs

Complete new patient intake: demographics, insurance details, referral information, and reason for visit

Receive and process referrals from physicians, facilities, and home health agencies

Coordinate care by scheduling appointments, following up on missing documents or orders, and keeping patients and providers informed

Verify insurance information and flag authorization needs for the appropriate team members

Communicate clearly and compassionately with patients, caregivers, and referring offices

Enter and update patient and referral records accurately in our system, on time

Escalate urgent or clinical concerns to the appropriate staff right away

Track referral status and intake metrics, and suggest ways to improve the process

Protect patient privacy and follow all company policies on data security and confidentiality



What we’re looking for

Experience in a call center, medical front office, patient intake, scheduling, or a similar customer-facing role

Excellent spoken and written English, with a calm, friendly, professional phone presence

Strong organization and follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple patients and tasks at once

Comfort with computers, data entry, and learning new software

Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information

Reliable high-speed internet, a secure home workspace, and a computer that meets our data security requirements (we do not provide equipment)



Nice to have: Wound care experience or familiarity with wound care terminology, plus experience with EHR or practice management software, insurance verification, or referral management. Knowledge of HIPAA is a plus.



Schedule

Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time, matching our California-based teams. In the Philippines, this is roughly 12:30 AM to 9:00 AM (Tuesday to Saturday local time) during Pacific Standard Time. When daylight saving time is in effect, it shifts to about 11:30 PM to 8:00 AM local time. Any schedule changes must be approved in advance by your manager.



What we offer

Full-time remote work with a US-based team

Paid training in our systems, intake workflows, and compliance policies

A meaningful role helping patients get timely access to care

Opportunities to grow into senior intake, care coordination, or administrative leadership roles, based on performance and business needs



Offers are contingent on a successful interview, signing a confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement, written agreement to follow our data security policies, and completion of HIPAA training before any access to protected health information. Employment is at-will.



To apply, send a 30 second introduction video along with your resume.

title: Youtube (Vlogs) Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a Video Editor with experience creating engaging YouTube and vlog-style content.



This role is best suited for someone who knows how to turn raw footage into a clear and enjoyable story, especially for travel, lifestyle, personality-led, and long-form YouTube content. Experience focused only on short-form reels, ads, corporate videos, or highly effects-driven editing may not be the best fit for this role.

---





WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Review raw footage and choose the best moments for each video

- Turn footage into clear, engaging YouTube vlog stories

- Create strong intros, smooth pacing, and endings that keep viewers interested

- Cut filler, repetition, and unnecessary footage

- Add subtitles, on-screen text, music, and sound effects

- Improve audio quality and keep voices clear and consistent

- Apply color correction and grading

- Use B-roll, transitions, zooms, graphics, and effects where appropriate

- Organize footage and project files properly

- Handle revisions and feedback efficiently

- Prepare polished 16:9 videos ready for YouTube





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- Experience editing YouTube videos, vlogs, travel, lifestyle, or personality-led content

- Strong sense of storytelling and pacing

- Able to identify which moments are worth keeping and which should be cut

- Good attention to audio, subtitles, timing, and visual consistency

- Comfortable editing phone-recorded and mixed-quality footage

- Comfortable working with CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, and other relevant editing tools

- Experience with motion graphics or more advanced editing is a plus

- Open to feedback and able to deliver polished work with minimal revisions

- Reliable, organized, and detail-oriented

- Able to handle private footage professionally and confidentially





WORK SETUP



- Full-time contractual role

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Philippine Time

- Time tracker required

- No moonlighting or outside full-time employment





HOW TO APPLY



To confirm that you’ve read the full job post, please type "HELLO YOUTUBE" as the very first sentence of your application.



After that, please provide:



1. Your CV link

2. Your portfolio link showing your best YouTube or vlog editing work

3. A short text introduction about your relevant video editing experience. Please keep it focused on experience related to this role.

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD, not hourly

title: Healthcare Referral Outreach Virtual Assistant
description:
Company: Harbor Home Care

Work Arrangement: Remote

Schedule: Part-time, 3 hours per day

Working Hours: 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Houston, Texas time (Central Time)



About the Position



Harbor Home Care is looking for an experienced and reliable Virtual Assistant with a background in U.S. home care or home health care. The primary responsibility of this role is to make outbound calls to healthcare facilities and potential referral sources to introduce our services, build professional relationships, and generate client referrals.



We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, a pleasant, professional phone voice, and a strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare industry, particularly home care and home health care in Texas.



Key Responsibilities



- Make outbound calls to hospitals, rehabilitation centers, assisted living facilities, nursing homes, and other potential referral sources.

- Introduce Harbor Home Care and explain our home care services.

- Connect with case managers, discharge planners, social workers, referral coordinators, and other decision-makers.

- Build and maintain professional relationships with healthcare facilities and referral partners.

- Follow up with potential referral sources as needed.

- Maintain accurate records of calls, contacts, follow-ups, and outreach results.

- Provide regular updates on outreach activities and progress.



Note: This position is primarily focused on outbound calling and referral outreach. It does not involve general administrative tasks or direct patient care.



Qualifications and Requirements



- Previous experience in U.S. home care or home health care is required.

- Good understanding of the U.S. healthcare system, particularly home care and home health care in Texas.

- Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and patient confidentiality.

- Basic understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, managed care plans, and health insurance.

- Experience communicating with healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, or referral coordinators is a strong advantage.

- Native-level or near-native English communication skills.

- Clear, pleasant, confident, and professional phone voice.

- Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

- Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and speaking with healthcare professionals.

- Self-motivated, organized, reliable, and results-oriented.

- Must have a stable internet connection and a quiet working environment.

title: Part-time Short-Form Trend Scout (IG Reels / TikTok), research only, no editing
description:
Hi! I'm a lifestyle creator based in Paris (~10k on Instagram, plus TikTok and YouTube). My content is Paris life, fashion as the look, beauty, and personal diary-style reels. I'm looking for someone with a real eye for short-form: what makes people stop, keep watching, and follow.



What you'll do (about 3–5 hours a week):

Every week, send me 5 reel ideas in a shared doc. Each idea includes:

  - a link to the reference video (trend, format or sound)

  - the sound to use, if it matters for the idea (and whether it's rising or already peaking)

  - why it works: the hook, what keeps people watching, and why someone would save, share or follow after it

  - 2–3 hook options adapted to me (on-screen text)

  - how I could make it with my life or footage (I'll share a short weekly update)

  - effort level: low (phone, existing footage) or medium



This is research and ideas only: no editing, no posting.



Where the ideas should come from:

Worldwide trends are welcome, but filtered through my world: an Asian woman living in Paris. That means what's working right now among French/European lifestyle, slow-living, fashion and beauty creators, and global formats that would make sense for someone living my life here. A trend that only works in another country or culture isn't useful to me.



This means training your feed. You'll follow the creators I send you (and find more) so your Reels/TikTok feed is full of Paris/European lifestyle content. If your feed doesn't look like my world, the ideas won't either.



Please no AI-generated ideas! I've seen many generic "5 trending audios this week" lists with no idea attached and I can tell. I want ideas from someone who actually watched the videos and thought about why they work for me.



Getting to know my account:

In your first weeks, study my profile: which of my posts did well and which didn't, and why. I'll share notes on what works for me (for example, series and personal stories turn viewers into followers; useful Paris guides get saves and reach). Also study creators similar to me, to see what works for them that I'm not doing yet. Your ideas should get more tailored to me every week. I'll give quick feedback on every idea so you can learn what works for me.



Who I'm trying to reach: women roughly 22–35, English-speaking (US, UK, Asia, and internationals living in Europe), who love Paris, style, beauty and real life, and who'd save a reel or send it to a friend. Ideas that go viral with the wrong crowd (shock bait, thirst traps, rage bait) aren't useful to me, even if they get big numbers.



You're a fit if you:

  - scroll Reels/TikTok daily and spot formats before they peak

  - understand the difference between a video that gets views and a video that gets followers

  - can explain in 2–3 sentences why a video went viral and why people watched to the end

  - genuinely like lifestyle, slow living, fashion or beauty content (bonus if you already follow European creators)

  - write natural, casual English



Pay: $30/week (~₱1,900) for 5 ideas a week, paid monthly. Starts with a short paid test ($10), then a 1-month trial. Pay is reviewed after 3 months.



Bonus: for any of your ideas I post, based on new followers from that post within 10 days (Instagram or TikTok): $3 for 50+, $10 for 200+, $40 for 1,000+. Max $50 in bonuses per month. The follower levels are reviewed every 3 months as the account grows. Bonuses count for ideas I adapt or post later too, and are paid with the next weekly payment along with a screenshot of the results.



To apply: start your message with "PARIS SCOUT" and send:

  1. A screenshot of your current Reels Explore or TikTok For You page (no need to change it, I just want to see what you watch)

  2. Links to 2 reels from the last 7 days that would work for a lifestyle/fashion creator in Paris, and for each one: why it gets watched to the end, and why someone would follow after it (2–3 sentences)

  3. Your hours per week and time zone

- Can suggest stronger angles, better storytelling, and improvements to the CTA.

- Understands how to improve a video's performance rather than simply following instructions.

- Can independently make creative decisions that strengthen the finished video.



**4. High-Quality Editing**



- Strong experience with TikTok Shop, UGC, and direct-response advertising.

- Excellent B-roll selection, visual storytelling, sound design, captions, and pacing.

- Every edit should serve a purpose, whether that's improving retention, explaining a benefit, or driving a purchase.



**5. Strong English Comprehension**



- Must understand spoken and written English very well.

- Must understand American slang, humor, natural speech, and emotional sales messaging.

- Must be able to communicate creative suggestions clearly in English.



### 📅 WORKLOAD & SCHEDULE



- **Minimum 5 completed videos per day.**

- **Average video length: 35-60 seconds.**

- Must maintain consistent quality and meet deadlines.

### ❌ THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



- You only know how to make basic caption edits.

- You rely entirely on generic CapCut templates.

- You add random effects without understanding their purpose.

- You cannot identify improvements in a script or video.

- You need instructions for every creative decision.

- You prioritize fancy editing over retention and sales.



### 💰 WHAT WE OFFER



- Consistent, high-volume paid work.

- Long-term opportunity with ongoing projects.

- Creative freedom to suggest improvements and test new ideas.

- Opportunity to grow alongside an established TikTok Shop creator.

- Compensation based on experience, skill level, and demonstrated performance.



### 📩 HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. **Portfolio:** Your 3 best short-form videos, preferably TikTok Shop, UGC, or direct-response advertisements.

2. **Results:** Examples of videos you've edited that generated strong views, retention, or sales (if available).

3. **Experience:** Explain your experience with viral TikTok frameworks and conversion-focused content.

4. **Creative Thinking:** Tell me how you would improve a TikTok Shop video that gets lots of views but very few purchases.

6. **Availability:** Whether you prefer working 6 or 7 days per week.



**Shortlisted applicants must be willing to complete a PAID trial edit.**

I'm looking for a long-term creative partner who can help make videos go viral AND convert into sales.



**If you understand the psychology of selling through short-form content, I want to hear from you.**

title: US Life Insurance Appointment Setter – Outbound Calling, Neutral American Accent – Part Time
description:
ABOUT US

Desmos Life is an independent life insurance agency in Utah, USA, run by two licensed agents. We help American homeowners get mortgage protection and term life insurance, often with no medical exam.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make a high number of outbound calls to US homeowners. Most are AGED LEADS: people who asked about mortgage protection months ago and haven't been helped yet. Some are fresh leads from our
 ads.

- Get past the first "who is this?", re-spark their interest, confirm a few basics (state, homeowner, rough age), and BOOK A PHONE APPOINTMENT with one of our licensed agents, or TRANSFER A HOT LEAD LIVE.

- Log every call in our CRM. It runs in Chrome and includes the dialer, so there's nothing to install.

- Set callbacks, and mark anyone who asks not to be called again.



You will NOT be selling insurance. You won't quote prices or give advice. Your job is strictly appointment setting and live transfers.



ENGLISH AND ACCENT: THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT

Our leads are everyday Americans, many aged 40-65, and they hang up fast on callers they can't understand. We are ONLY hiring callers who sound clear, natural and easy to understand to an American ear.

- Near-native, fluent spoken English with a NEUTRAL, LIGHT ACCENT. Clear pronunciation (v/b, f/p, th) and natural American rhythm and intonation, not a read-from-a-script sound.

- You can handle fast talkers, Southern accents and interruptions without losing your place.

- You can make small talk and handle objections naturally.

- Strong accent? Please don't apply. We listen to every recording, and accent clarity is the first thing we screen for.



OTHER REQUIREMENTS

- At least 1 year of outbound calling to US consumers (insurance, final expense, mortgage, solar or appointment setting preferred)

- Comfortable with aged leads, high call volume and hearing "no" many times a day

- Stable internet (a backup connection preferred), a quiet room with no background noise, a computer with Chrome, and a noise-canceling USB headset

- Fast and accurate at typing call notes

- Reliable: you show up for every shift on time

-Based on performance, their is opportunity to transition to full time

SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday, about 6:00am-11:00am Manila time, 20 hours per week. That's 5-9pm in the Eastern US and Texas, when people are home from work. From March to November, US daylight time moves the shift one hour earlier.



PAY

$4-$5 USD per hour, depending on experience and how you sound on the phone.



HOW TO APPLY 

1. Start your message with the word "DESMOS".

2. Attach ONE voice recording, 2-3 minutes long, recorded with your work headset in the room you'd work from. In it:

   a) Introduce yourself and describe your US calling experience, talking naturally without reading.

   b) Read this opener the way you'd say it on a real call: "Hi, is this John? Hey John, this is Maria with Desmos Life. A while back you asked about protecting your mortgage, and I'm just following up. Did you ever get that taken care of?"

   c) Answer this objection the way you would on a call: "I don't remember filling anything out. Take me off your list."

3. Tell us your internet speed (a speed test screenshot) and whether you have a backup connection.

4. List your previous calling jobs: the company, what you called about, and for how long.



Shortlisted applicants will do a live 10-minute mock call with us over video, including a role-play with a skeptical homeowner, before any offer.

title: SENIOR BRAND, CREATIVE & UI DESIGNER
description:
Employment Type: Part-Time or Full-Time  

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote  

Location: Philippines

Department: Brand & Creative



About the Companies:

We operate two accounting brands serving growing businesses across North America, with annual revenues ranging from $2M to $50M.



Firm Five is a fractional accounting firm providing ongoing accounting and financial support to growing businesses. We focus on building strong client relationships and delivering personalized financial services.



Baseline Accounting is a project-based accounting firm specializing in system migrations, bookkeeping cleanups, and finance technology solutions that help businesses build accurate, organized, and AI-ready financial systems.



Both brands serve the North American market and are building a strong, recognizable presence across digital platforms.



About the Role:

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Brand, Creative & UI Designer who combines artistic talent, strategic thinking, and a strong understanding of modern branding.

This is not a conventional graphic design position. We want someone with the eye of an artist, the thinking of a brand designer, and the ability to turn creative concepts into polished, high-quality digital experiences.

You will take ownership of the visual identity of both companies across websites, social media, personal brands, marketing materials, presentations, proposals, and video content.

You should understand what makes a brand look established, credible, and memorable, particularly within the North American market.

We're looking for someone who can create original work, not simply assemble templates or rely on AI-generated designs. Your portfolio should demonstrate genuine artistic ability, excellent taste, and a consistent standard of execution.

We are looking for the best of the best. Someone who can elevate our brands, challenge existing ideas, and bring a high level of creativity to everything they produce.



Key Responsibilities



1. Brand Identity & Creative Direction

- Develop and maintain distinct brand identities and visual guidelines for both companies.

- Establish consistent standards for typography, colors, layouts, photography, illustrations, and iconography.

- Ensure all visual materials reflect the quality and positioning of each brand.

- Identify opportunities to improve and elevate existing brand assets.

- Maintain consistency across websites, social media, presentations, and other marketing channels.



2. Digital Design & UI

- Design and improve website interfaces, landing pages, and other digital experiences.

- Create clean, modern, professional layouts with strong visual hierarchy and usability.

- Develop website graphics, visual elements, and branded components.

- Replace generic or placeholder website imagery with carefully selected or custom-designed visuals.

- Ensure designs are visually appealing, intuitive, and appropriate for the target audience.

- Apply UI design principles to create cohesive and polished digital experiences.



3. Social Media & Personal Branding

- Design LinkedIn banners, profile visuals, social media graphics, and branded content.

- Develop consistent visual systems for company and individual professional profiles.

- Create engaging carousels, educational graphics, and other social media formats.

- Help establish a recognizable visual identity across company leadership and team profiles.

- Maintain an authentic, approachable, and professional brand presence.



4. Creative Asset Development

- Design marketing graphics, advertising creatives, and promotional materials.

- Develop professional sales decks, proposals, one-pagers, and service sheets.

- Create reusable design templates for recurring content.

- Produce high-quality visual assets for digital campaigns and landing pages.

- Develop original illustrations, graphics, and visual concepts where appropriate.



5. Video & Data Visualization

- Transform financial information, screenshots, numbers, and graphs into clear, engaging visuals.

- Create charts, callouts, lower thirds, and data overlays for video content.

- Prepare assets in multiple formats, including vertical, square, and widescreen.

- Deliver organized, production-ready visual assets to the video editing team.



6. Creative Research & Concept Development

- Research leading North American brands, professional services firms, and SaaS companies.

- Identify creative trends and visual approaches that can strengthen our market positioning.

- Pitch original design concepts and content formats for both brands.

- Recommend creative approaches for client success stories, educational content, team features, and promotional materials.

- Bring fresh ideas and continuously look for ways to improve our visual identity.



Qualifications & Requirements:

- At least 3–5 years of professional experience in brand design, graphic design, UI design, or a related creative field.

- An exceptional portfolio demonstrating strong artistic ability, branding, and visual design.

- Experience creating professional brands or digital experiences for B2B companies, professional services, or SaaS businesses.

- A strong understanding of North American design aesthetics, branding standards, and target audiences.

- Excellent eye for typography, composition, color theory, layout, and visual storytelling.

- Experience developing brand identities and maintaining consistency across multiple platforms.

- Experience with website design, UI layouts, and digital interfaces.

- Strong experience creating social media graphics, LinkedIn assets, and personal branding materials.

- Proficiency in professional design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

- Ability to create original designs and artwork without relying on AI-generated outputs.

- Strong attention to detail and an uncompromising standard for design quality.

- Ability to translate business and financial information into clear, attractive visual content.

- Excellent communication, organization, and time management skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.

- Must have a reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a suitable work-from-home setup.



Nice to Have:

- Experience working with North American companies or international clients.

- Experience in accounting, finance, legal, or SaaS branding.

- Strong UI/UX design capabilities.

- Experience with website platforms such as Webflow, WordPress, or Hostinger.

- Knowledge of motion graphics and animated social media content.

- Experience developing brand guidelines from scratch.

- Illustration or other traditional and digital art skills.



How to Apply

We are looking for outstanding designers, and your portfolio will be one of the most important parts of your application.



Please submit:

1. Your updated resume.

2. A link to your professional design portfolio.

3. Samples of your best branding, graphic design, UI, and social media projects.

4. At least one example of how you helped transform or elevate a company's visual identity.

5. Before-and-after examples, if available.

6. A brief explanation of your creative contribution to the submitted projects, including which parts you personally designed.

7. A description of your experience designing for North American or international audiences, if applicable.



Important: We are looking for original creative work. AI-generated designs, AI-created portfolio samples, or portfolios consisting primarily of ready-made templates will not meet our expectations. We want to see your actual design skills, creative thinking, and artistic ability.

Applications without a portfolio and relevant work samples will not be considered.



Recruitment Process

1. Portfolio Review

We evaluate artistic ability, design quality, creativity, consistency, originality, and overall visual judgment.



2. Initial Interview

A discussion of your experience, creative process, previous projects, and approach to branding and design.



3. Live Portfolio Walkthrough

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to walk us through selected portfolio projects, explain their design decisions, and demonstrate their personal contributions.



4. Paid Practical Assessment

Candidates will complete a paid design exercise involving:

- Creating a personal LinkedIn banner aligned with one of our brands.

- Turning financial data into a polished, video-ready chart.

- Proposing three original creative content formats.

- Demonstrating their ability to create professional, original visual work.



5. Technical Assessment & Reference Checks

We will review computer specifications, work equipment, technical capabilities, and professional references.



What We Value:

We value exceptional creativity, originality, artistic judgment, and attention to detail.

We are not simply looking for someone who can follow instructions or produce graphics quickly. We want a designer who understands what great design looks like, knows how to elevate a brand, and takes genuine pride in their craft.

If you have the talent, taste, and creative ability to make brands stand out in the North American market, we'd love to see your work.

title: Multifamily Underwriting & Financial Modeling Tutor
description:
I'm a commercial real estate professional specializing in multifamily investment sales. I'm seeking a part-time private tutor to teach me multifamily underwriting and financial modeling the way it's taught in a university-level real estate development program — structured, rigorous, and built around a proper textbook curriculum.



This is a teaching engagement, not a one-off training session. I want someone who can guide me from fundamentals through a complete, self-built multifamily underwriting and waterfall model, with assessments along the way to prove I've actually learned the material.



At a glance:

• Role: Private tutor / instructor 

• Schedule: Twice per week (two 60–90 minute remote sessions)

• Format: Fully remote via Zoom/Teams with screen sharing and Excel work-alongs

• Rate: $5.5/hour USD (paid via Wise)

• Start date: Immediate, upon successful interview



What You'll Be Teaching:

A structured curriculum of your own proposal, modeled on a university real estate development / real estate finance program, working out of a recognized textbook (e.g., Peter Linneman's Real Estate Finance and Investments or comparable). You will propose the syllabus and textbook in your application.



Core topic areas:

1. Foundations — time value of money, NPV/IRR/MIRR, cap rates, NOI, basis points, leverage concepts

2. Multifamily underwriting — rent rolls, market rents, vacancy and loss to lease, operating expenses and expense ratios, capital expenditures, debt terms (amortization, DSCR, loan sizing), investor pro forma conventions

3. Financial modeling in Excel — building a complete multifamily acquisition model from scratch, with sensitivity tables, scenario analysis, and clean formatting standards

4. Waterfalls and syndication math — preferred returns, return of capital, catch-up tranches, promote/carried interest, IRR-hurdle-based distribution waterfalls for LP/GP structures

5. Development topics — land/entitlement basics, ground-up feasibility analysis, construction budgeting and draws, permanent loan takeout, developer profit and developer waterfalls



Curriculum Structure Requirements:

• University-style curriculum: You will map out a semester-style syllabus with weekly topics tied to assigned textbook readings before we begin.

• Work out of a textbook: Each session should build on assigned reading and problem sets.

• Quizzes: Short quizzes at regular mile markers (roughly every 3–4 weeks) covering prior material.

title: Experienced B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter | $8–$10/hr + Bonuses | US Recruiting Firm
description:
**ABOUT WAYMARK HR GROUP**



Waymark HR Group is a growing recruiting and HR consulting firm based in Western New York, USA. We help small and medium-sized businesses find qualified employees, overcome hiring challenges, and take the recruiting burden off business owners.



Our founder has nearly 15 years of HR experience and understands the challenges employers face when trying to attract and hire the right people.



We are looking for an experienced, confident, and results-driven B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to help us grow our client base.



This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder of a growing American business, with the potential for additional hours, increased earnings, and a long-term working relationship based on performance.



**ABOUT THE POSITION**



Your primary responsibility is to contact U.S. businesses that are actively hiring, identify employers who could benefit from our recruiting services, and schedule qualified introductory meetings with our founder.



You will NOT be responsible for closing sales, negotiating contracts, recruiting candidates, or collecting payments.



We are looking for someone who can have genuine business conversations, build trust, overcome objections, and create interest without sounding robotic or overly aggressive. (THIS IS IMPORTANT!)



**COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE**



- $8–$10 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

- $25 USD bonus for every qualified appointment that takes place.

- $100 USD additional bonus for every successful recruiting placement generated through your outreach once the client has paid Waymark.

- 20 hours per week.

- Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

- Fully remote.

- Initial paid 30-day trial period.

- Opportunity for additional hours and long-term work based on performance and business needs.



This is NOT a commission-only position. You will receive hourly compensation in addition to performance bonuses.



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**



- Make outbound cold calls to U.S. businesses using provided prospect lists.

- Navigate gatekeepers and connect with business owners, presidents, hiring managers, HR leaders, and other decision-makers.

- Introduce Waymark HR Group and professionally communicate the value of our recruiting services.

- Ask qualification questions to understand an employer's current hiring needs and challenges.

- Handle common objections with confidence and professionalism.

- Schedule qualified introductory meetings directly on the founder's calendar.

- Follow up with interested prospects who are not ready to schedule an immediate meeting.

- Accurately document call outcomes, conversations, and follow-up activities.

- Maintain organized prospect records and provide a brief daily activity report.

- Participate in occasional training, feedback, and call-review sessions.

- Respect requests not to be contacted again and follow company outreach procedures.



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**



- At least two years of experience in B2B cold calling or outbound appointment setting targeting U.S. businesses.

- Excellent spoken English that is clear, natural, professional, and easily understood by U.S. business owners.

- Strong listening and conversational skills.

- Experience navigating gatekeepers and reaching decision-makers.

- Strong objection-handling skills and the ability to think quickly during conversations.

- Confidence speaking with business owners and senior-level professionals.

- Ability to handle rejection while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.

- Experience using CRM systems, spreadsheets, or outbound calling software.

- Strong attention to detail, reliability, and personal accountability.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and a quiet working environment.

- Consistent availability during the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**



Experience in any of the following areas is highly desirable but not required:



- Recruiting or staffing agency business development.

- HR services or professional services sales.

- B2B sales development.

- Manufacturing, construction, skilled trades, or professional services.

- Selling services to small and medium-sized U.S. businesses.



**WHAT WE PROVIDE**



- Targeted business prospect lists.

- Company-provided calling software.

- Cold-calling scripts and objection-handling guidance.

- Training on our company, recruiting services, and target clients.

- A defined appointment-setting process.

- Direct access to the founder for questions, feedback, and support.

- Fair hourly compensation with meaningful performance incentives.



**WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED APPOINTMENT?**



A qualified appointment is a scheduled meeting with a business owner or appropriate hiring decision-maker at a company that meets our target client criteria, has a legitimate hiring need, understands the purpose of the meeting, and attends the scheduled conversation.



A sale is NOT required for you to earn the $25 qualified appointment bonus.



**HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS**



We value quality over quantity.



While consistent outbound calling activity is important, we are primarily interested in meaningful conversations, qualified business opportunities, appointments that take place, and accurate follow-up.



We want someone who takes pride in their work and understands that every conversation represents our company's reputation.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Please begin your application with the words "WAYMARK GROWTH" so we know you have read the complete job description.



Include the following:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your U.S. B2B cold-calling experience.



2. The industries you have previously targeted and the types of decision-makers you have contacted.



3. Your previous performance results, including average calls made, appointments booked, and appointments attended per week, if available. Please distinguish cold outreach from warm or inbound leads.



4. The CRM systems and calling software you have experience using.



5. Your desired hourly rate, earliest available start date, and confirmation that you can work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.



6. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording containing the following:



- Briefly introduce yourself and describe your relevant experience.

- Imagine you are calling the owner of a U.S. manufacturing company that has been advertising an open position for several weeks. Introduce yourself as a representative of Waymark HR Group and demonstrate how you would start that conversation.



Please use your natural speaking voice. We are evaluating communication, confidence, professionalism, and your ability to engage a business owner, not your ability to read a prepared script.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to participate in a video interview and live cold-calling role-play.



We are looking for an experienced sales professional who wants to contribute to the growth of an American recruiting firm and be rewarded for producing meaningful results.



NEW leads are added DAILY. We just need someone who is professional, hungry, and wants to make $$$$!



If that sounds like you, we look forward to hearing from you!
