title: AI Outreach & Engagement Operator
description:
Purpose of the Role

Strategic VA builds and runs the system that turns LinkedIn attention into booked appointments. She sets up and maintains the AI tools, automated campaigns and scheduled tasks behind Sonja's outreach, engages personally with prospects as Sonja, and tracks what works so the team can sharpen its content and engagement strategy.



The pipeline starts on LinkedIn. Automated Dripify campaigns and personal engagement bring people in, and traffic flows to several destinations (webinars, Executive Roundtables, landing pages and the booking page) where people sign up to learn about cybersecurity, AI risk and AI governance. Strategic VA owns the process from first touch through the booked appointment.



We are looking for someone strategic and highly motivated who wants to help build an ecosystem of AI tools, not just follow a checklist.



Possible Schedule: 

Sun 6-8pm PST

Mon 5-10am, 6-9pm PST

Tues 5-10am, 6-9pm PST

Wed 5-10am, 6-9pm PST

Thurs 5-10am, 6-9pm PST 

Fri 5-10am PST, no Friday afternoon/evenings



Please propose a 20 hour weekly schedule. Ideally you will work a couple hours in the morning and a couple hours in the evening. This will enable us to stay on top of LinkedIn connection accepts and message replies. 



To be done during US business hours 



Core Responsibilities

- Build the System

- Set up and connect the tools that run outreach: Dripify, Sales Navigator, GoHighLevel, Trello or ClickUp, and an automation tool such as Make.

- Build AI agents and scheduled tasks with Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT and Copilot: lead research, reply drafting, list cleanup and reporting.

- Route new leads automatically into the contact database and the right follow-up sequence.

- Document each workflow so it can be maintained and improved.

- Run the Pipeline

- Launch and monitor automated LinkedIn campaigns, staying within LinkedIn's weekly invitation limits and the 50 monthly InMail credits.

- Send people to the right destination: webinar, Executive Roundtable, landing page or booking page.

- Run invitation, reminder and follow-up campaigns for each event.

- Move every interested lead through to a booked appointment with Sonja.

- Engage as Sonja

- Engage on prospects' profiles: like and comment on posts, and endorse skills.

- Reply to messages personally in Sonja's voice, warm, specific and direct.

- Recommendations only for people Sonja has actually worked with.

- Measure and Improve

- Track sends, acceptance rate, replies, sign-ups and appointments booked.

- Find the best days and times to post and engage.

- Build and refine personas: who engages most, when, and what they are curious about.

- Send a weekly report to Sonja and Renee with results and recommendations for content and engagement strategy.



Compensation

- First month: $500.

- Performance bonus: paid on top of base pay for strong results (see structure below).

- Longer-term opportunity: strong performance in the first month opens the opportunity to be hired on for a longer-term agreement, with ongoing pay of roughly $500 to $800 per month.



What Strategic VA Brings

- Strategic thinking and strong self-motivation

- Hands-on experience building automations and AI workflows

- Fluency with LinkedIn, Sales Navigator and Dripify (or similar)

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM, and Trello or ClickUp

- Daily use of Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT or Copilot; Make or Zapier a plus

- Excellent written English and the judgment to write as Sonja

- Comfort with metrics and turning data into recommendations



Success Measures

- Systems live, documented and running reliably

- Steady growth in replies, sign-ups and booked appointments

- Every reply answered or routed within 12 hours

- Weekly report on time, with clear persona and timing insights

title: Chief of Staff – Entrepreneurial, Fast-Moving Problem Solver
description:
About the Position



We are looking for an exceptional, highly driven Operations Manager who moves extremely fast, takes initiative, solves problems independently, and gets things done.

We are NOT looking for a passive manager who waits for instructions, needs constant supervision, or simply delegates tasks.

We want an aggressive, ambitious, hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who takes complete ownership of their responsibilities and consistently delivers results.

The ideal candidate is a natural problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, attacks challenges head-on, and figures things out without waiting for someone else to provide the answers.

Speed, execution, resourcefulness, and accountability are extremely important to us.



Key Responsibilities



- Operations Management: Oversee daily business operations, eliminate bottlenecks, improve efficiency, and ensure work gets completed quickly.

- Sales Management: Lead and support sales teams, improve conversions, increase revenue, and drive performance.

- Hiring & Recruiting: Identify, interview, hire, train, and manage high-performing employees.

- Project Management: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, establish priorities, coordinate teams, and ensure deadlines are met.

- Team Leadership & Accountability: Set expectations, track performance, follow up consistently, and address underperformance immediately.

- Problem Solving: Proactively identify problems, investigate solutions, make decisions, and take action without waiting for instructions.

- Process Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to simplify operations, reduce costs, improve productivity, and increase profitability.

- Executive Support: Work directly with company leadership to execute important initiatives, manage priorities, and ensure projects move forward.

- Hands-On Execution: Personally jump into projects and tasks whenever necessary to get results.



Personality & Work Ethic – MOST IMPORTANT



We are specifically looking for someone with the following characteristics:

- Extremely Fast-Moving: Works with an exceptional sense of urgency and executes quickly.

- Aggressive Problem Solver: Attacks problems immediately and doesn't stop until a solution is found.

- Highly Proactive: Identifies what needs to be done and takes action without being told.

- Hustler Mentality: Ambitious, energetic, hardworking, and constantly looking for ways to accomplish more.

- Resourceful: Figures things out independently, even when faced with unfamiliar challenges.

- Action-Oriented: Spends more time executing than discussing or planning.

- Strong Leadership: Comfortable directing teams, making decisions, and holding people accountable.

- Highly Organized: Can manage numerous projects, employees, and priorities without losing track of details.

- Results-Driven: Focuses on measurable outcomes rather than simply completing assigned hours.

- Entrepreneurial Mindset: Thinks like a business owner and takes personal responsibility for results.

- Independent Thinker: Brings solutions, recommendations, and completed work instead of constantly asking what to do next.

- Hands-On: Willing to roll up their sleeves and personally do whatever is necessary to get the job done.



Required Experience & Qualifications



- Previous experience in Operations Management, Sales Management, Business Management, Project Management, Chief of Staff, or a similar leadership role.

- Experience as a high-level Executive Assistant supporting a CEO, founder, or entrepreneur is also welcome, provided the role involved significant operational responsibility and independent execution.

- Strong sales experience, preferably including managing salespeople or sales processes.

- Experience recruiting, interviewing, hiring, training, and managing employees.

- Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.

- Proven ability to lead remote teams and hold employees accountable.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable learning and using CRM systems, project management software, AI tools, and other business technology.



Who We Are NOT Looking For



This position is NOT a good fit if you:

- Wait for instructions before taking action.

- Need constant supervision or follow-up.

- Move slowly or struggle with urgency.

- Identify problems but don't propose solutions.

- Prefer delegating everything instead of getting involved.

- Avoid difficult conversations or holding employees accountable.

- Become overwhelmed when managing multiple responsibilities.

- Are primarily experienced in administrative tasks such as scheduling meetings, managing calendars, or responding to
s.



Who Will Excel in This Position



We want someone who wakes up every day looking for opportunities to improve the business, solve problems, and accomplish more.

Someone who sees a problem and immediately takes ownership of solving it.

Someone who can manage people, drive sales, hire talent, organize projects, and personally execute when necessary.

Instead of saying, "What would you like me to do?" we want someone who says, "I identified the problem, figured out the solution, and already took care of it."

We value people who are ambitious, independent, exceptionally productive, and motivated by achieving results.

Applications without a video will not be considered.

Real Estate & CRM Experience: Prior experience as a Real Estate Lead Manager, ISA, or Acquisitions Assistant in the U.S. market is strongly preferred. Experience using REsimpli is a major plus.

Start your message subject line with the exact phrase: EZ Inbound Pro

title: GoHighLevel & AI Operations Specialist (Claude + Meta Ads) – US Marketing Agency
description:
READ THIS FIRST: Please read the whole post. How to apply is at the bottom.



About us

WellnessLeads is a US marketing agency that helps med spas and aesthetic clinics get new patients. We run their Meta 
 and Instagram) ads and build their funnels in GoHighLevel. Then our in-house booking team calls every lead and books them in. We work with about 15 clinics across the US.



I'm Josh Steinberg, the founder. You'll work directly with me. Website: wellnessleads.co



The role

You'll do our client work using Claude (an AI assistant) plus the step-by-step processes and Notion guides we've already built. Claude does most of the building. Your job is to run it, check everything it makes, fix what it gets wrong, and finish the parts it can't do. Over time you'll make more of the day-to-day decisions yourself.



What you'll do each week

• Build offer landing pages and quiz funnels in GoHighLevel

• Set up new client campaigns in GHL: custom values, calendars, forms, workflows and funnels

• Write Meta ad copy and research competitor offers in the Meta Ad Library

• Build call scripts in Canva and booking-team SOPs in Notion

• Fix rejected Meta ads and resubmit them

• Register client phone numbers for A2P in GHL

• Prepare our weekly campaign review: pull the numbers, draft what's working and what isn't, and draft each client's update

• Keep our Notion guides up to date when something changes



That's the job. We won't pile unrelated admin work on top of it. If the role changes, we'll talk first and adjust your pay to match.



Must have

• 2+ years of GoHighLevel experience at a marketing agency (funnels, forms, calendars, workflows, custom values, snapshots)

• Hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience, including duplicating ads and reading delivery errors and rejections

• You use Claude or ChatGPT every day for real work and can show us an example

• Strong written English, because clients will read what you write

• A reliable computer, stable internet and backup power



Nice to have

• Experience marketing med spas, healthcare or wellness businesses

• Canva, Notion, Trello, Zapier, or Google Sheets and Apps Script



People who do well here

• Check AI's work instead of trusting it

• Make a decision once they have enough information, and explain why

• Bring a recommendation, not just a question

• Fix the process when something breaks, not just the one task

• Ask questions when something is unclear. I'd much rather you ask than guess



What success looks like

• After 30 days: you've run each of our main processes with my review, and your work needs only small edits.

• After 90 days: you launch new client campaigns end to end and fix ad rejections on your own.

• After 6 months: you run the weekly campaign review and send client updates, and I only step in for big decisions.



Pay and schedule

• $500–$1,300 USD per month, full time (40 hours a week), based on experience

• Paid twice a month, plus 15 paid days off per year

• Pay review at 90 days, then every 6 months

• Fixed schedule, Monday to Friday. At least 4 hours must overlap with 9am–5pm US Eastern, which is 10pm–6am Philippine time (9pm–5am from March to early November)

• Long-term role. We provide Claude and all the software accounts you need



Room to grow

As we add clients, this role grows into leading client delivery and training new team members.



How to apply

1.  Start your application message with the word EVOLVE.

2.  In 3–5 sentences, tell us about a GoHighLevel build you're proud of.

3.  Include a Loom video (3 minutes max) showing a GHL or AI workflow you built. Explain one decision you made in it.

4.  Attach your resume.



We won't review applications that skip any of these steps.



What happens next

1.  We reply to every shortlisted applicant within 5 business days.

2.  Shortlisted applicants do a paid test task (2–3 hours, $30 USD).

3.  Next comes a video interview.

4.  Last is a 2-week paid trial on real work, before a long-term offer.



Questions about the role are welcome. Send them with your application.

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
## —About us—



Battling Monsters is the program of Just Care More and primarily follows the stories of Sandra and Jamie: wingsuit BASE jumping, paragliding and alpine climbing, filmed as honest stories about fear, risk and getting back up. We reach about 560,000 followers across YouTube, Instagram,
 and TikTok, with two YouTube videos a month and daily short-form content. Behind the channel is Just Care More, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit that uses those stories to reach people who are fighting their own monsters, through its content and impact campaigns in prisons, rehab centres, group homes and schools.



We are a small team and we are growing it: you would be the first hire, followed by a long-form editor whom you will brief and coordinate.



## —The role—



You run our four social networks end to end: strategy, calendar, short-form editing, publishing, community and reporting, and you are the keeper of our footage archive. You are the single point of contact for the channel day to day, so that the founders can focus on filming, partnerships and the nonprofit's impact work. You edit the reels and shorts yourself; a long-form editor cuts the YouTube videos from your briefs. 



## —What you will do—



**Strategy and growth**



- Own and maintain our social media strategy, with a platform-specific plan for Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube: how each one grows followers, reach and engagement, and how it sends viewers to YouTube.

- Keep brand guidelines for social media and make sure the voice and messaging are consistent on every platform and support the wider mission: inspiring people facing adversity towards self improvement using adventure sports & adventure travel.

- Research successful accounts, competitor posts, trending topics, sounds and formats, and turn what works into posts and videos of our own.



**Ideas and content development**



- Keep an idea bank of about 100 ideas a month across our reel types (short sport, montage, our story, behind the scenes, motivational, campaign related, YouTube promotional), long form videos and carousels and pick the top potential options for the calendar.

- Mine our content library for content worth developing into videos and posts. You will know the footage better than anyone, because you categorize it (see below).

- Write the hooks and concepts for short-form videos.

- Develop every youtube video: title, thumbnail concept, hook and logline, with A/B/C thumbnail and title tests. Sign off the editor's storyboard before the cut.

- Long-form videos must reach 40% average retention. You own the assets (i.e cover, title), the storyboard sign-off and the feedback loop with the editor that gets them there.

- Give the founders a shoot list each cycle if needed: what the calendar needs filmed, interviews for youtube videos, and which backstories are missing for posts.



**Calendar, production and briefs**



- Build the monthly content calendar in Notion together with the founders: fill it from the idea bank plus executive team must-post items and campaign specific posts, and move each piece from idea to posted. The founders approve the calendar monthly.

- Coordinate the production and posting of two long-form videos a month, about 30 short-form videos a month, daily stories and two weekly photo carousels.

- Keep the production calendar scheduled at least 14 days ahead of today at all times.

- Brief the long-form editor for every YouTube video on the calendar, and specify the platform-specific versions each piece needs.

- Write all copy: captions for every post, titles, descriptions, CTAs, hashtags, in the brand voice.

- Choose the audio for every reel: trending, royalty-free or none. Before anything is scheduled, check that the music choice will not trigger a copyright claim.



**Short-form editing**



- Edit the roughly 30 reels and shorts a month yourself, preferably in DaVinci Resolve, from the content library and incoming footage: hook text on screen, captions, audio, pacing to the hook.

- Story graphics, carousel and photo-post layouts



**Content library and categorizing**



- Own the categorizing and classification of all our content: the existing archive of more than 30 TB and every incoming drop from shoots, so that every clip is described, rated and findable.

- Review and approve the AI categorizing proposals, keep the Content Library current, and flag footage gaps to the founders.

- Know the archive well enough to answer "do we have a shot of X" from memory most of the time.



**Publishing**



- Schedule and publish everything on all four networks through Metricool at our set posting times (7:00 AM and 9:00 AM California time) or the best time per network where the data says otherwise.

- Make sure every post type follows our per-network SOPs (reels, stories, albums, YouTube uploads,
 link posts each have one) for format, tags, links, CTAs and posting rules.

- Daily stories with the right tags, links and CTAs with high engagers saved to Instagram highlights

- YouTube housekeeping: tags, cards, end screens, chapters, playlists.



**Community**



- Reply to comments and DMs on all four networks in our voice, pin strategic comments, moderate spam and hate.

- Count and report the "impact messages" we receive each cycle and pass them to the founders and the PR team. That number is one of our two most important goals to measure impact.

- Escalate important conversations to the founders, and spot people with stories of adversity and transformation who could become part of the wider mission and future podcast. Community management here is more than replying to comments.

- Flag collaboration opportunities that show up in the audience. For example recent followers/subscribers with stories that align with our brand



**Reporting**



- Monitor the analytics and KPIs of all four networks continuously, and call out top-performing and underperforming content as it happens.

- Feed high-performing content back into the idea bank each cycle, scaled up a format: a story that did well becomes a reel, a reel or a day with unusually high engagement becomes a candidate long-form video or topic.

- One short report per 10-day cycle, per network: growth against our 2% target, views, watch time and retention, CTR, saves and shares, impact messages.

- Weekly KPI call with Sandra; feed retention and hook data back to the editors.



**Team**



- Brief and coordinate the long-form editor, plus any occasional freelancers.



## —What we are looking for—



- You have run a multi-network calendar for one brand or creator, ideally in outdoor, adventure or action sports.

- You have managed people and tasks before: freelancers, editors or a small team, with deadlines you were accountable for. You will manage the long-form editor, outsourced thumbnail design and other freelancers as the team grows.

- You write hooks and captions that sound like a person, not a brand.

- You edit short-form video confidently and fast, and can show reels you cut yourself. DaVinci Resolve preferred; if you work in Premiere or CapCut you must be willing to switch.

- You are methodical with large media libraries: naming, metadata, ratings, folder discipline. You will be responsible for more than 30 TB of footage.

- You are fluent in Metricool (or a close equivalent), Google Drive, YouTube Studio and the native platforms of Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube.

- You have hands-on experience working in Notion: databases, calendars, templates and briefs, not just notes. Our content calendar and SOPs live there.

- You are organized enough to run a 10-day cycle without being chased, and honest enough to tell us when something is not working.

- You are comfortable with the themes of our content: real risk, fear, injury and recovery, mental health, and the nonprofit's work with people in prisons and rehab.

- English at native or near-native level.

- You can publish during the California morning posting window, and you can work with founders who travel and are sometimes offline for days.

- You own an iPhone and a MacBook (needed to access the social network accounts and our tools) and have reliable internet of at least 30 Mbps.

- You are familiar with AI tools for content creation and social media management, and use them in your day-to-day work.



**Bonus skills**



- Using Davinci Resolve for editing

- Deeper AI experience: building automations for content and social media work.



If you have either, say so in your application and tell us how you have used them.



## —Terms—



- Independent contractor, remote, anywhere in the world.

- approximately 40 hours a week; compensation set monthly salary with monthly bonuses based on performance

- Paid trial task for shortlisted candidates (see below), then a 30-day trial period.

- Start date: start of December 2026, so that your first full cycle runs before the end of the year.



## —How to apply—



1. Links to two accounts or channels you have managed, and your roles and responsibilities with these channels and any accomplishments

2. Links to three reels or shorts you edited yourself, and which software you used.

3. Why you think you are the best fit for this job position

4. What is the biggest suggestion to improve youtube performance of videos and increase views? 

5. Your monthly rate and your location.

6. Confirmation that you have an iPhone, a MacBook and at least 30 Mbps internet, plus any long-form editing or AI experience you want us to know about.



## —Our process—



1. Applications reviewed as they arrive; shortlisted candidates invited to a 30-minute call (late November).

2. you will receive a Paid trial task 

3. Decision and contract first week of December

4. Onboarding and your first supervised cycle in December.

title: Operations Manager – High-Performance, Entrepreneurial Leader
description:
Location: Philippines (Remote)Employment Type: Full-Time



About the Position



We are looking for an exceptional, highly driven Operations Manager who moves extremely fast, takes initiative, solves problems independently, and gets things done.

We are NOT looking for a passive manager who waits for instructions, needs constant supervision, or simply delegates tasks.

We want an aggressive, ambitious, hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who takes complete ownership of their responsibilities and consistently delivers results.

The ideal candidate is a natural problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, attacks challenges head-on, and figures things out without waiting for someone else to provide the answers.

Speed, execution, resourcefulness, and accountability are extremely important to us.



Key Responsibilities



- Operations Management: Oversee daily business operations, eliminate bottlenecks, improve efficiency, and ensure work gets completed quickly.

- Sales Management: Lead and support sales teams, improve conversions, increase revenue, and drive performance.

- Hiring & Recruiting: Identify, interview, hire, train, and manage high-performing employees.

- Project Management: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, establish priorities, coordinate teams, and ensure deadlines are met.

- Team Leadership & Accountability: Set expectations, track performance, follow up consistently, and address underperformance immediately.

- Problem Solving: Proactively identify problems, investigate solutions, make decisions, and take action without waiting for instructions.

- Process Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to simplify operations, reduce costs, improve productivity, and increase profitability.

- Executive Support: Work directly with company leadership to execute important initiatives, manage priorities, and ensure projects move forward.

- Hands-On Execution: Personally jump into projects and tasks whenever necessary to get results.



Personality & Work Ethic – MOST IMPORTANT



We are specifically looking for someone with the following characteristics:

- Extremely Fast-Moving: Works with an exceptional sense of urgency and executes quickly.

- Aggressive Problem Solver: Attacks problems immediately and doesn't stop until a solution is found.

- Highly Proactive: Identifies what needs to be done and takes action without being told.

- Hustler Mentality: Ambitious, energetic, hardworking, and constantly looking for ways to accomplish more.

- Resourceful: Figures things out independently, even when faced with unfamiliar challenges.

- Action-Oriented: Spends more time executing than discussing or planning.

- Strong Leadership: Comfortable directing teams, making decisions, and holding people accountable.

- Highly Organized: Can manage numerous projects, employees, and priorities without losing track of details.

- Results-Driven: Focuses on measurable outcomes rather than simply completing assigned hours.

- Entrepreneurial Mindset: Thinks like a business owner and takes personal responsibility for results.

- Independent Thinker: Brings solutions, recommendations, and completed work instead of constantly asking what to do next.

- Hands-On: Willing to roll up their sleeves and personally do whatever is necessary to get the job done.



Required Experience & Qualifications



- Previous experience in Operations Management, Sales Management, Business Management, Project Management, Chief of Staff, or a similar leadership role.

- Experience as a high-level Executive Assistant supporting a CEO, founder, or entrepreneur is also welcome, provided the role involved significant operational responsibility and independent execution.

- Strong sales experience, preferably including managing salespeople or sales processes.

- Experience recruiting, interviewing, hiring, training, and managing employees.

- Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.

- Proven ability to lead remote teams and hold employees accountable.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable learning and using CRM systems, project management software, AI tools, and other business technology.



Who We Are NOT Looking For



This position is NOT a good fit if you:

- Wait for instructions before taking action.

- Need constant supervision or follow-up.

- Move slowly or struggle with urgency.

- Identify problems but don't propose solutions.

- Prefer delegating everything instead of getting involved.

- Avoid difficult conversations or holding employees accountable.

- Become overwhelmed when managing multiple responsibilities.

- Are primarily experienced in administrative tasks such as scheduling meetings, managing calendars, or responding to
s.



Who Will Excel in This Position



We want someone who wakes up every day looking for opportunities to improve the business, solve problems, and accomplish more.

Someone who sees a problem and immediately takes ownership of solving it.

Someone who can manage people, drive sales, hire talent, organize projects, and personally execute when necessary.

Instead of saying, "What would you like me to do?" we want someone who says, "I identified the problem, figured out the solution, and already took care of it."

We value people who are ambitious, independent, exceptionally productive, and motivated by achieving results.



How to Apply



Please submit a short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself, describing your relevant experience, and explaining why you're a great fit for this role.

Applications without a video will not be considered.

s.

title: Fundraising Research & Outreach Assistant
description:
# Fundraising Research & Outreach Assistant



### About the Project



I'm looking for a resourceful and proactive research and outreach assistant to help promote a charitable fundraising campaign supporting a family in the Philippines who is struggling to provide food and essential care for their beloved cats.



The family has been caring for their cats for more than five years, including rescued animals. They are currently experiencing financial difficulties, and we're looking for genuine people, organizations, and businesses that may be willing to support their situation.



This is a charitable fundraising initiative, not a business investment opportunity.



### Responsibilities



- Research potential individual donors, philanthropists, animal welfare advocates, and charitable organizations.

- Identify business owners, executives, foundations, and companies that may offer sponsorships or donations.

- Research pet food manufacturers, distributors, and businesses that may provide cat food or essential supplies.

- Find relevant decision-makers and their publicly available professional contact information.

- Identify potential supporters on LinkedIn and other professional platforms.

- Prepare personalized outreach messages and follow-ups.

- Help promote the fundraiser through relevant communities and networks.

- Maintain an organized spreadsheet of prospects, contact information, outreach status, and responses.

- Provide regular progress updates.



### Ideal Candidate



- Experience in lead generation, prospect research, fundraising, business development, or outreach.

- Comfortable researching philanthropists, business owners, executives, and organizations.

- Good written English communication skills.

- Able to write personalized, natural, and respectful outreach messages.

- Familiar with LinkedIn, Google Search, spreadsheets, and online research.

- Resourceful, organized, and detail-oriented.

- Able to distinguish genuine opportunities from suspicious offers or potential scams.



### Application Requirements



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Relevant experience in lead generation, research, fundraising, or outreach.

3. Examples of previous research or outreach work, if available.

4. Your expected hourly rate and availability.



### Practical Assessment



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short research exercise.



**Task 1: Fundraiser Promotion**



Review the campaign and prepare a natural LinkedIn post that could be shared to help spread awareness.



Fundraiser:





**Task 2: Find Three Potential Supporters**



Research three real people, organizations, or businesses that could potentially help this campaign.



For each prospect, provide:



- Full name or organization name.

- Current position or organization description.

- LinkedIn profile or official website.

- Why you believe they could be relevant to this campaign.

- Their publicly available professional contact channel, if available.

- A short personalized introductory message you would send.



We are particularly interested in people or organizations involved in philanthropy, animal welfare, pet food sponsorships, charitable giving, or community support.



**Task 3: Outreach Strategy**



Briefly explain how you would approach these three prospects and how you would encourage them to support or share the campaign without sounding pushy.



### Important



- All prospects must be real and independently verifiable.

- Do not invent contact details, positions, or organizational information.

- Do not send messages or make donation requests on our behalf during the assessment.

- Do not pay for access to donor lists or private contact information.

- We value quality research and thoughtful outreach over the number of contacts collected.



The assessment is intended to take approximately 30-45 minutes.



### Position Details



- Work arrangement: Remote

- Employment type: Part-time

- Working hours: [Insert hours]

- Compensation: [Insert hourly rate or agreed project rate]

- Start date: [Insert date]



If you're interested in using your research and outreach skills to help a meaningful cause, we'd love to hear from you.

IMMERSIV is a Brisbane real-time 3D and PropTech studio. We build interactive property experiences for off-the-plan developments, used by some of Australia’s leading developers and builders. We have two products. LivePlan covers interactive masterplans and house-and-land. LiveView covers apartment interiors and exteriors. We want a senior artist who is also technical: someone who can take a project from CAD plans to a polished, optimised real-time tour. You’ll build the houses, apartments and masterplans in 3ds Max, then bring them into Unreal, set up lighting and materials, and make sure they run well when streamed. You’ll also help set the modelling and UE standards for the rest of the team.



What you’ll do



Build clean, accurate models from DWG/CAD plans and elevations in 3ds Max, matching the drawings exactly. That includes houses, interiors, apartments and full masterplans with roads, kerbs, landscaping and community buildings

Model and detail to a high standard: window and door frames, trims, setbacks, hardware, with bevelled edges and sensible naming and layers



Use RailClone, Forest Pack and Corona for repeating elements, scattering and stills

Set up scenes in UE5 with Lumen and MegaLights, create materials, and handle level layout, Blueprints and interaction

Profile and optimise tours for load time, frame rate and memory, and package them for Pixel Streaming

Work with Cesium for Unreal and large terrain/site data

Contribute to our pipeline tools (Python, MAXScript, UE Python/Blueprint) and our Gaussian splat workflows

Mentor other artists and help keep modelling and Unreal standards consistent across projects



What you’ll bring



5+ years in architectural visualisation, real-time 3D or games

Expert in 3ds Max, with strong modelling fundamentals: clean topology, accurate to plan, easy for others to edit

Strong Unreal Engine 5 experience: Lumen, materials, Blueprints, packaging and performance profiling

Able to read architectural drawings (plans, elevations, sections, window schedules)

A good eye for realism in materials, lighting, planting and composition

Scripting in Python and/or MAXScript, or a willingness to pick it up fast

Familiar with Perforce or similar version control

Self-directed. You can own a project and spot problems before the client does



Nice to have



Pixel Streaming / WebRTC experience

Gaussian splatting (capture, training, web viewers such as PlayCanvas or Three.js)

Corona or V-Ray for stills

Blender

Experience in PropTech or real estate marketing



Why IMMERSIV



You’ll work on real projects that go to market, used by buyers and sales teams around Australia.

You will work with current technology (UE5, Gaussian splatting, AI-assisted pipelines) and have room to shape how we use it.



How to apply

Send your CV and a portfolio or reel to 
 include render and real-time work and anything built from CAD plans.

description:
About Memtech Acoustics

Memtech Acoustics was established in 2001 in Rochester Hills, Michigan. For over 25 years we have diagnosed, designed and delivered engineered noise and vibration control solutions across more than 2,000 projects for industrial, commercial, institutional, healthcare, hospitality and government clients. We are not a materials reseller. We measure the problem, engineer the solution and validate the result, and our motto is simple: under promise, over deliver. Memtech is an MBE Certified minority owned business, led by a Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses alumnus, and a member of the Michigan Hispanic Chamber of Commerce and the Southeast Michigan Chamber of Commerce. Our team works across the United States, the Philippines and South Africa, with clear goals and real ownership. We don't believe in work/life balance. We live it.



The Role

As our Brand & Marketing Associate, you own the content pipeline for an acoustic engineering firm with a technical story to tell. You will partner directly with the Managing Principal on brand and marketing strategy, turn priorities into clear plans, and represent our expertise through virtual lunch and learns, our podcast, and online engagement with architects, general contractors, and AEC firms. The pace is fast and the standard is exact. This is a full time, fully remote role, with flexible scheduling, training and room to grow.



Key Performance Outcomes

- 8 content pieces published per month across LinkedIn, the blog, and the newsletter

- 25% LinkedIn follower growth year over year, with 25 target AEC accounts actively engaged per quarter

- 3 virtual lunch and learns per quarter with target audiences

- 5 qualified inbound marketing leads per quarter, tracked in GoHighLevel

- 100% brand voice compliance in published content

- 2 new Apollo.io outreach sequences per quarter, with documented performance metrics

- Positive attitude, collaborative spirit, and consistent team engagement



Key Responsibilities

- Brand Stewardship: Protect Memtech's brand voice, technical accuracy, and audience positioning across every touchpoint.

- Brand and Marketing Strategy: Work with the Managing Principal to shape positioning and strategy for each key audience, then turn priorities into clear action plans.

- Content Development: Run the content pipeline across LinkedIn, the blog, newsletters, and other channels, tailored to each audience segment.

- Industry Engagement: Attend virtual lunch and learns to record them and create content, and represent Memtech's expertise on podcasts and online.

- Industry News and Perspective: Build tools that surface current news in acoustics, noise control, and construction, then add Memtech's expert perspective in published commentary.

- Social Media, Outreach, and Community: Manage posting across LinkedIn,
, Instagram, and other channels, expand Apollo.io outreach into new segments, and engage regularly with target accounts, partners, associations, and publications.

- Competitor Analysis: Track other acoustic engineering firms to find positioning gaps and ways for Memtech to stand out.

- Ad Performance and Analytics: Work with our Ad Manager on campaign results, ROI, creative, messaging, and targeting. Measure content and outreach results and adjust based on what works.

- Podcast Support: Help plan and run our podcast, including guest outreach, content planning, appearing on camera as needed, and production coordination.

- SOP Documentation: Document marketing systems and build standard operating procedures with the Managing Principal.



Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- 2+ years of marketing or content development experience

- Excellent written English, with work samples that show attention to brand voice and consistency

- Able to work full days, 8 AM to 5 PM US Eastern Time, from a remote setup with reliable internet



Nice to Have

- Experience marketing engineering, construction, or other technical services

- Familiarity with Apollo.io, GoHighLevel, beehiiv, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite

- Experience with AI-assisted content workflows, video, or podcasts



How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note describing one marketing or content project you owned end to end: the problem, your approach, how you measured success, and what you would do differently. Links to published work or content samples are welcome.

title: AI Video UGC Ad Creator / Editor
description:

.

- Strong attention to realism, including skin detail, lighting, facial movement, voice quality, and believable expressions.

- Proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar video-editing software.

- Ability to maintain character identity and visual consistency across separate generations and scenes.

- Reliable daily output, responsiveness, and clear communication.

- English proficiency

- Experience with 
 and Gmail



**All required AI tools will be provided**



**Please apply only if you have already created realistic AI Avatar / UGC videos.** We require examples of your previous work as part of the application.



### Tools and Workflow



Our current production workflow uses:



- Google Flow / Veo

- CapCut

- 

- Gmail



You should be comfortable working with these tools or have experience with comparable alternatives.



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. **Portfolio:** Share 2–3 examples of AI-generated UGC or spokesperson advertisements you personally created. At least one example must clearly demonstrate realistic lip-sync.

title: Hiring Manager – Virtual Assistant Recruitment (Philippines)
description:
We are an established online support business looking for an experienced Hiring Manager to lead our recruitment efforts in the Philippines.



We are seeking someone with a proven track record of recruiting, screening, interviewing, and selecting high-quality Virtual Assistants (VAs) for remote positions.



Prior experience hiring Virtual Assistants is required. We need someone who can independently manage the entire hiring process, from sourcing candidates to conducting multiple rounds of interviews and recommending the best applicants.



Key Responsibilities



Candidate Sourcing: Find and attract qualified Filipino Virtual Assistants through job boards, recruitment platforms, and other hiring channels.



Initial Screening: Review applications, evaluate resumes, and conduct preliminary screenings to identify qualified candidates.



Multiple Interview Rounds: Organize and conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' communication skills, experience, reliability, and suitability.



Skills Assessment: Develop and administer practical assessments to evaluate candidates' abilities in customer support, problem-solving, and multitasking.



Candidate Evaluation: Compare applicants, identify strengths and weaknesses, and provide detailed recommendations.



Recruitment Management: Manage multiple job openings simultaneously while maintaining an organized recruitment pipeline.



Hiring Coordination: Present shortlisted candidates to management and coordinate final interviews and onboarding handoffs.



Requirements



Proven experience recruiting and hiring Virtual Assistants, preferably in the Philippines.



Previous experience as a Hiring Manager, Recruiter, or Talent Acquisition Specialist.



Strong experience conducting multiple rounds of structured interviews.



Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.



Ability to identify dependable, professional, and detail-oriented candidates.



Experience hiring for customer support, live chat, administrative, or other remote support positions.



Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple candidates and vacancies simultaneously.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Familiarity with recruitment platforms such as OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn, and Indeed is preferred.



What We're Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply posts job advertisements and forwards resumes.



We need a hands-on Hiring Manager who takes ownership of the recruitment process, thoroughly evaluates candidates, and ensures that only the most qualified applicants move forward.



Our ideal candidate understands the challenges of managing remote teams and knows how to identify applicants who are dependable, communicate effectively, follow instructions, and perform well in a fast-paced online support environment.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



Your resume and a brief summary of your recruiting experience.



Details about your previous experience hiring Filipino Virtual Assistants.



Approximately how many employees you have successfully recruited.



A description of your typical screening and interview process.



As part of your application, describe a real hiring situation where you interviewed multiple Filipino VA candidates but ultimately rejected your initial top choice. Explain what changed your decision, how you evaluated the remaining candidates, and what the final hiring outcome was. Please use a specific example from your own recruiting experience rather than a hypothetical scenario.



Important: Applications without relevant recruitment experience will not be considered. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously managed the hiring process for remote Virtual Assistants.

title: Full-Time Maintenance & Repair Manager — NYC Apartment Buildings (Remote, Philippines Only)
description:
We are a US-based real estate company managing apartment houses across the boroughs of New York City. We are hiring a full-time, long-term Maintenance & Repair Manager to run day-to-day maintenance and repairs across our NYC portfolio, working remotely from the Philippines.



Location: Remote — Philippines only. Work from home in the Philippines.

Category: Maintenance / Property Management



What you'll do:

- Receive and triage tenant maintenance requests / work orders; prioritize by urgency

- Dispatch and coordinate vendors and contractors (plumbers, electricians, HVAC techs, handymen) — get quotes, compare, schedule, follow up

- Handle emergency calls after hours — assess the situation, dispatch help, follow through until resolved

- Schedule and track preventive maintenance (boilers, HVAC, elevators, common areas, seasonal items)

- Coordinate inspections; follow up on violations and corrections

- Track every job from request to completion; keep owners/managers updated

- Maintain vendor lists, service records, and maintenance logs



What we're looking for:

- 5+ years coordinating maintenance/repairs for residential apartment buildings (US properties strongly preferred)

- Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and general building systems — enough to diagnose issues, scope work, and talk shop with contractors

- Familiarity with NYC building codes and common violations a big plus

- Experience managing vendors: sourcing, quotes, scheduling, quality follow-up

- Excellent written and spoken English; calm under pressure on emergency calls

- Reliable high-speed internet + backup

- Able to work full-time New York hours and be on call for after-hours emergencies

- AppFolio (maintenance module) or similar property-management software a big plus



What we offer:

- Full-time, long-term remote role

- Salary up to ₱80,000/month, based on experience

- 13th-month pay

- Paid time off



To apply, answer these in your application (applications without answers will not be considered):

1. How many years have you coordinated maintenance/repairs for residential apartment buildings? Describe the portfolio (how many units/buildings, where).

2. Walk through an emergency repair you handled end-to-end — e.g. a burst pipe or heat outage. What did you do first, who did you call, how did you follow through?

3. How do you manage vendors/contractors — sourcing, quotes, scheduling, and making sure the job actually gets done right?

4. What property-management or maintenance software have you used (AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, etc.)? What did you do in it?

5. What is your internet speed + backup setup? Are you able to work full-time New York hours and be on call for after-hours emergencies? What monthly salary are you looking for (USD)?

title: HR & Training Coordinator
description:
An HR and Training Coordinator for a home health and hospice manages the full employee lifecycle, focusing on recruiting, onboarding, and training staff in compliance with healthcare regulations. They ensure high-quality patient care by coordinating mandatory training, maintaining personnel records, managing benefits, and fostering employee engagement in a compassionate care environment. 



Key Responsibilities

Recruitment & Staffing: Source, interview, and onboard new hospice employees (nurses, aides, social workers) to meet staffing needs and compliance standards.

Training & Education: Develop, coordinate, and deliver training programs, including orientation for new hires, in-services on hospice care, safety protocols, and regulatory updates (CMS, state laws).

Regulatory Compliance: Maintain employee personnel files in accordance with hospice regulations and accreditation standards, ensuring certifications, licenses, and background checks are up-to-date.

Employee Relations & Engagement: Serve as the primary contact for HR-related questions, benefits administration, employee recognition, and conflict resolution, maintaining a supportive, compassionate culture.

Performance Management: Coordinate annual evaluations, competency checks, and mandatory skill assessments. 



Qualifications:



Experience: 1–3+ years of experience in HR, preferably within a healthcare, home health, or hospice environment.

Knowledge (nice to have) Strong understanding of employment law and, ideally, Medicare/Medicaid hospice benefit regulations.

Skills: Excellent communication, organizational skills, proficiency in HRIS/electronic health records, and empathy. 



EXPERIENCED recruiters only.  We already have some resumes on-hand and successful candidate will be calling them, doing initial interview, request for HR requirements and ensure completion, etc.

title: Backend Developer (Mid-Level)
description:
We are currently looking for a Mid-Level Backend Developer who can help oversee the technical foundation of an existing Payment Terminal Management Platform. The ideal candidate will have substantial backend development experience and be comfortable working on transaction-based systems.



This position will focus on keeping backend operations running smoothly, ensuring accurate handling of transaction data, maintaining API connections, and introducing system enhancements to support the platform's evolving business requirements.

-Ensure the continued functionality and maintenance of existing backend systems, services, and APIs.



-Build and deliver backend solutions that address new product requirements and business needs.



-Handle SQL database operations, particularly those involving transaction records and related information.



-Ensure proper communication and integration between backend services, the management dashboard, and connected systems.



-Investigate backend errors, perform debugging, and resolve technical concerns.



-Identify areas for improvement in system speed, data processing, and overall backend stability.



-Work alongside the Product Owner and frontend developer to coordinate development activities and platform enhancements.



-Contribute to code evaluations, testing activities, and the documentation of backend updates.

-At least 5 years of professional backend development experience, preferably working with payment terminal management platforms or comparable transaction-processing systems.



-Strong practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js for building backend applications and APIs.



-Proficient in SQL and Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS), including writing queries, retrieving records, and -managing database information.



-Experience developing RESTful APIs and working with Git Version Control.



-Capable of diagnosing and resolving backend issues through debugging, testing, and ongoing application maintenance.



-Familiarity or practical experience with Python for backend-related development, scripting, or automation.



-Good English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical approaches and decisions clearly.



Additional Experience That Would Be an Advantage

-Understanding of payment processing operations, transaction data handling, and payment terminal integrations.



-Background in connecting backend services with dashboards, frontend applications, and external third-party systems.



-Experience enhancing backend systems to achieve better performance, scalability, reliability, and data management efficiency.



🕒 Work Schedule: 4:00 PM – 12:00 MN Philippine Time

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator – Spearfishing / Ocean
description:
Remote freelance / part-time opportunity | Four-week paid trial | Ongoing potential



I’m launching a social media channel focused on spearfishing, freediving, marine life and ocean adventures. I have an extensive archive of high-resolution underwater footage from years of diving, spearfishing and travel, and I’m looking for a creative editor who can help turn it into cinematic, authentic short-form content.



You will work directly with me to:

• Review and organise underwater footage

• Identify strong moments, stories and content ideas

• Edit engaging Instagram Reels, TikTok videos and YouTube Shorts

• Develop a consistent visual style

• Prepare basic captions and a simple content calendar

• Help schedule approved content and review basic engagement results



The style should be immersive, natural and story-led: thoughtful pacing, strong music and sound design, natural colour grading, and no excessive transitions or generic influencer effects.



You should:

• Have a strong eye for storytelling, pacing and visual composition

• Be confident with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut or similar

• Be able to handle high-resolution footage

• Communicate clearly, work independently and contribute creative ideas

• Be reliable and interested in a long-term collaboration



A genuine interest in spearfishing, freediving, marine life, surfing, ocean conservation or adventure filmmaking is a major advantage. Formal qualifications are not essential; early-career and self-taught editors are welcome.



Initial four-week paid trial:

• 8–12 short-form videos

• Basic captions and scheduling

• Organisation of footage used

• A simple ongoing content calendar

title: YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager
description:
About Us:

Lemuria Citi is a personal brand focused on relationships, intimacy, emotional awareness, self-discovery, and personal growth.



Our content is educational, conversational, thought-provoking, and occasionally playful or provocative. We create meaningful conversations that encourage curiosity, connection, and personal growth.



We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager to help us produce engaging, high-quality content for YouTube and Instagram.



This is a long-term, part-time opportunity for someone who can combine excellent video editing skills with creativity, organization, and an understanding of social media growth.



Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Content Creation

- Edit approximately 1 long-form YouTube video per week (typically 8–20 minutes).

- Repurpose long-form videos into approximately 2 engaging YouTube Shorts/Instagram Reels per week.

- Create compelling hooks, clean captions, intentional B-roll, tasteful graphics, and on-screen text.

- Maintain professional audio, color, pacing, and overall production quality.

- Design eye-catching, on-brand YouTube thumbnails and Instagram Reel covers.



YouTube & Instagram Management:

- Write compelling, SEO-optimized YouTube titles, descriptions, and chapters.

- Prepare Instagram captions and relevant hashtags.

- Organize content using a shared content calendar.

- Schedule and publish approved content.

- Monitor basic performance metrics and recommend improvements.

- Help identify opportunities to improve audience engagement, retention, and discoverability.



Creative Collaboration:

- Work directly with our Content Manager, who will provide creative direction and final approval.

- Suggest creative ways to make educational talking-head videos more visually engaging.

- Maintain consistent branding across YouTube and Instagram.

- Manage assigned tasks independently and meet agreed deadlines.



Our Editing Style:

This is extremely important to us.



We are NOT looking for overly flashy editing, constant zoom effects, random stock footage, excessive transitions, or generic AI-generated visuals.



We want someone who can create content that feels:

- Polished, elevated, and professional

- Natural, authentic, and conversational

- Visually interesting without being distracting

- Thoughtful, creative, and intentional

- Modern, clean, and appealing to both men and women



Our videos are primarily educational talking-head content. Your creativity should enhance the message, not overpower it.



We value editors who understand storytelling, pacing, and when to let a powerful message speak for itself.



Qualifications:

- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos and short-form content.

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional editing software.

- Experience creating high-quality YouTube thumbnails and social media graphics.

- Understanding of YouTube SEO, audience retention, and content optimization.

- Familiarity with YouTube Studio, Instagram, and Meta Business Suite.

- Strong written English and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, stay organized, and communicate consistently.

- Comfortable working with educational content discussing relationships, intimacy, sexuality, and personal development.



Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Gling, CapCut, or AI-assisted editing tools is a plus.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

2. Links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited, preferably educational, talking-head, or storytelling content.

3. Links to 2–3 YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels you've edited.

4. Examples of YouTube thumbnails you've designed.

5. Your experience managing YouTube and/or Instagram accounts.

6. Your preferred editing software and typical workflow.

7. Your expected hourly rate within our advertised range.



**Please also answer these three questions:**



1. How would you make a 15-minute educational talking-head video more engaging without relying on excessive effects or random B-roll?



2. Describe your process for turning one long-form YouTube video into two compelling Shorts or Reels.



3. Have you managed YouTube or Instagram accounts beyond editing? If so, what responsibilities did you handle, and what results can you share?



We are looking for someone who genuinely understands content creation, not simply someone who can cut and assemble footage.



If you're a creative editor who values storytelling, quality, and thoughtful collaboration, we'd love to see your work!

title: Virtual Receptionist & Appointment Setter – Answer Calls, Take Notes, Book Appointments (US B2B, Eastern Hours)
description:
tart date: Tuesday, December 1, 2026



Working hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time (10:00 PM–7:00 AM Philippine Time), with a 1-hour break.



Pay: USD $4.00 per hour to start (about $690 per month for 40 hours/week), with a $0.50/hour raise every 6 months of good performance, plus commission:

- $10 for every plant visit or quote call you book that actually takes place;

- 2% of the gross profit on orders from new customers you booked, for their first 12 months.

Paid semi-monthly via Wise or PayPal. Paid time off after 90 days. Long-term role for the right person.



ABOUT US – WHAT WE DO

BascoLube Associates LLC (
) is a specialty lubricant supplier based in the Atlanta, Georgia area, USA. We sell the greases, oils, anti-seize compounds and aerosols that keep factory machines running: bearings, gearboxes, chains, compressors and hydraulics.



- Our customers: maintenance managers, reliability engineers and purchasing agents at manufacturing plants, food and beverage plants, bottlers, pharmaceutical plants, drilling and mining companies across the United States.

- What we sell: we are the authorized US distributor for HUSKEY™ specialty lubricants, a Nye Lubricants reseller, and we also supply Klüber, FUCHS, Mobil and many other brands. A big part of our business is food-grade (NSF H1) lubricants for plants that must pass food-safety audits.

- How we sell: a plant contacts us (phone call, text, website chat, quote form or our free "lubrication survey"). We find out which machines they have and what problem they face (downtime, leaks, heat, washdown, hard-to-find product), then the owner recommends the right product and sends a quote, a free sample, or visits the plant in person.

- Your role in this: you are the first voice customers hear. You do two things: (1) book appointments for the owner, and (2) for every other caller, collect their details and find out exactly what they need, so the owner can follow up. You do not give prices, technical advice or product recommendations; the owner does that. You do not need to know lubricants.



We are a small, owner-run team, so you will work directly with the owner.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your job has two parts:



1. Book appointments

- Book on-site plant visits and quote/consultation calls with the owner directly on our calendar.

- Send the customer a short confirmation (date, time, address or phone number).



2. For everyone else: take their information and find out what they want

- Answer our business phone calls, return missed calls and call-back requests, and reply to customer text messages (Quo app) and website chat leads.

- Collect the caller's details: name, company, plant location, phone,
, and the best time to reach them.

- Find out exactly what they need: which product or brand, quantity and package size, which machine or problem, and how soon they need it.

- Tell them politely that the owner will get back to them with the answer or quote, and write down when they expect to hear back.

- Do not give prices, stock or delivery promises, discounts or technical advice. Just listen, ask, and take accurate notes.



RECORD EVERYTHING IN PIPEDRIVE (OUR CRM)

Every website form, chat and text already creates a deal in our sales pipeline at the "New Lead" stage. You will:

- check the "New Lead" stage at the start of each shift and contact every new lead the same day;

- add or correct the person and organization (name, company, plant location, phone,
);

- write the call notes on the deal using our template (who, company, what they need, quantity, timeline, next step);

- create the next activity for the owner (call back with quote, plant visit, quote call) with a due date;

- put booked appointments in both the owner's calendar and Pipedrive;

- at the end of each shift, send the owner a short summary: appointments booked, new requests and what each customer wants.



ABOUT PIPEDRIVE – THE CRM YOU WILL USE EVERY DAY

Pipedrive (
) is a popular sales CRM. Think of it as our shared to-do list and customer notebook:

- Deals: every customer request is a "deal" card. Cards sit in columns ("stages") on a board, from "New Lead" to quote sent, won or lost, so we can see every open request at a glance.

- Contacts: each deal is linked to a person (name, phone,
) and an organization (company and plant address).

- Notes: your call and text notes go on the deal, so the owner can read exactly what the customer asked for before calling back.

- Activities: calls, plant visits and quote calls are scheduled as activities with a date and time. They show up in the owner's calendar and in a daily to-do list, so nothing is forgotten.

- Automatic leads: our website forms, website chat and texts to our business number create new deals in Pipedrive automatically. Your first job each shift is to work through that "New Lead" column.

- Mobile app: Pipedrive has a phone app as well as the web version; you will mainly use the web version on your computer.



You do not need to be a Pipedrive expert. We give you your own login and a short training session in your first week, plus a simple note template to follow. If you have used Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho or a similar CRM before, you will feel at home within a day or two.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English (neutral, clear accent; you will answer calls from US plant managers).

- Proven phone experience (receptionist, call center, inside sales or appointment setting) and fast, accurate note-taking.

- At least 1 year experience as an appointment setter, inside sales rep, customer service rep or virtual assistant for a US company.

- Hands-on experience with a CRM (Pipedrive strongly preferred; HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho also OK). You must be comfortable logging notes, activities and moving deals between stages every day.

- Comfortable with Google Calendar/Workspace and business texting apps (Quo/OpenPhone, Dialpad, RingCentral or similar).

- Reliable computer, noise-cancelling headset, stable internet (at least 25 Mbps) and a backup (mobile data or power backup).

- Able to work US Eastern business hours consistently.



BIG PLUS (tell us at the top of your application)

- Experience in our industry: lubricants, oil and grease, industrial supply / MRO distributors, bearings and power transmission, chemicals, or automotive and heavy-equipment parts. If you have taken calls or orders from US plants, maintenance teams or purchasing departments, we especially want to hear from you.



NICE TO HAVE

- Pipedrive experience (please mention it at the top of your application).

- Basic Spanish.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "HUSKEY" so we know you read the full post.

2. Answer the screening questions below.

3. Attach a 1–2 minute voice recording (or Loom/Vocaroo link) introducing yourself in English and explaining how you would greet a customer who texts "Do you have Klüber grease in stock?"

4. Send your resume.



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.



SCREENING QUESTIONS (answer in your application)

1. Describe your last appointment-setting or customer service job: company, country of customers, how many calls/messages per day, and how many appointments you booked per week.

2. Which CRM tools have you used (Pipedrive?) and for how long? Describe exactly what you did in them every day (deals, stages, notes, activities, reports).

3. Which business phone/texting apps have you used?

4. Have you worked with lubricants, industrial supplies, MRO, bearings, chemicals or automotive/heavy-equipment parts? Which company, what products, and what was your role?

5. Are you able to work 9:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday–Friday, long term? Do you have any other job during those hours?

6. Describe your internet speed, your backup internet and your backup power.

7. A customer calls asking for a price and whether a product is in stock. You are not allowed to give prices. What exactly do you say, and what information do you collect before you hang up?

8. This role pays USD $4.00/hour to start, plus a $0.50/hour raise every 6 months and commission on appointments and new-customer orders. Is that acceptable?

9. This role starts on Tuesday, December 1, 2026. Can you start on that date? If you currently have another job, how much notice do you need to give?

We are looking for an exceptional, highly driven Operations Manager who moves extremely fast, takes initiative, solves problems independently, and gets things done.

We are NOT looking for a passive manager who waits for instructions, needs constant supervision, or simply delegates tasks.

We want an aggressive, ambitious, hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who takes complete ownership of their responsibilities and consistently delivers results.

The ideal candidate is a natural problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, attacks challenges head-on, and figures things out without waiting for someone else to provide the answers.

Speed, execution, resourcefulness, and accountability are extremely important to us.



Key Responsibilities

- Sales Management: Lead and support sales teams, improve conversions, increase revenue, and drive performance.

- Hiring & Recruiting: Identify, interview, hire, train, and manage high-performing employees.

- Project Management: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, establish priorities, coordinate teams, and ensure deadlines are met.

- Team Leadership & Accountability: Set expectations, track performance, follow up consistently, and address underperformance immediately.

- Problem Solving: Proactively identify problems, investigate solutions, make decisions, and take action without waiting for instructions.

- Process Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to simplify operations, reduce costs, improve productivity, and increase profitability.

- Executive Support: Work directly with company leadership to execute important initiatives, manage priorities, and ensure projects move forward.

- Hands-On Execution: Personally jump into projects and tasks whenever necessary to get results.



Personality & Work Ethic – MOST IMPORTANT



We are specifically looking for someone with the following characteristics:

- Extremely Fast-Moving: Works with an exceptional sense of urgency and executes quickly.

- Aggressive Problem Solver: Attacks problems immediately and doesn't stop until a solution is found.

- Highly Proactive: Identifies what needs to be done and takes action without being told.

- Hustler Mentality: Ambitious, energetic, hardworking, and constantly looking for ways to accomplish more.

- Resourceful: Figures things out independently, even when faced with unfamiliar challenges.

- Action-Oriented: Spends more time executing than discussing or planning.

- Strong Leadership: Comfortable directing teams, making decisions, and holding people accountable.

- Highly Organized: Can manage numerous projects, employees, and priorities without losing track of details.

- Results-Driven: Focuses on measurable outcomes rather than simply completing assigned hours.

- Entrepreneurial Mindset: Thinks like a business owner and takes personal responsibility for results.

- Independent Thinker: Brings solutions, recommendations, and completed work instead of constantly asking what to do next.

- Hands-On: Willing to roll up their sleeves and personally do whatever is necessary to get the job done.



Required Experience & Qualifications



- Previous experience in Operations Management, Sales Management, Business Management, Project Management, Chief of Staff, or a similar leadership role.

- Experience as a high-level Executive Assistant supporting a CEO, founder, or entrepreneur is also welcome, provided the role involved significant operational responsibility and independent execution.

- Strong sales experience, preferably including managing salespeople or sales processes.

- Experience recruiting, interviewing, hiring, training, and managing employees.

- Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.

- Proven ability to lead remote teams and hold employees accountable.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable learning and using CRM systems, project management software, AI tools, and other business technology.



Who We Are NOT Looking For



This position is NOT a good fit if you:

- Wait for instructions before taking action.

- Need constant supervision or follow-up.

- Move slowly or struggle with urgency.

- Identify problems but don't propose solutions.

- Prefer delegating everything instead of getting involved.

- Avoid difficult conversations or holding employees accountable.

- Become overwhelmed when managing multiple responsibilities.

- Are primarily experienced in administrative tasks such as scheduling meetings, managing calendars, or responding to
s.



Who Will Excel in This Position



We want someone who wakes up every day looking for opportunities to improve the business, solve problems, and accomplish more.

Someone who sees a problem and immediately takes ownership of solving it.

Someone who can manage people, drive sales, hire talent, organize projects, and personally execute when necessary.

Instead of saying, "What would you like me to do?" we want someone who says, "I identified the problem, figured out the solution, and already took care of it."

We value people who are ambitious, independent, exceptionally productive, and motivated by achieving results.



How to Apply

Applications without a video will not be considered.
