title: Patient Experience & Practice Operations Assistant (US Optometry)
description:
PATIENT EXPERIENCE & PRACTICE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

Virtual Assistant: Patient Communications, Insurance Posting, KPIs & Quality Control

Ocean Park Optometry | Santa Monica, California | Full Time, Long Term, Remote





ABOUT OCEAN PARK OPTOMETRY



Ocean Park Optometry is a busy, patient focused optometry practice in Santa Monica, California, where our promise is simple: See Better, Live Brighter. We provide advanced, personalized eye care including dry eye treatment, myopia management, scleral lenses, NeuroVisual Medicine, concierge eye care, and luxury eyewear.



We are building a cohesive, high functioning, elite team of eye care professionals to scale our business by providing outstanding customer service, products, and services. Every member of our team is professional in demeanor, speech, appearance, and actions, and that standard applies equally to our remote team.





THE ROLE



We are seeking a polished, highly dependable Virtual Assistant to be a warm and professional voice of our practice by phone,
, and text, while keeping our back office accurate, organized, and on time.



You will also serve as our quality control partner. You will audit that all work across the practice is completed on time, catch anything that is missed, and proactively stop things from falling through the cracks. You will track key performance indicators (KPIs) that drive constant improvement in our processes, our business growth, and the quality of every patient's experience.



This is a long term, full time position for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates beautifully, and enjoys being an essential part of a collaborative team.





SCHEDULE



You must be available to work our California business hours:



• Tuesday through Friday, 8:25 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time

• Saturday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time



Please apply only if you can reliably work these hours and have stable high speed internet, a dependable computer with dual monitors, a quality headset, and a quiet professional workspace. Backup internet and power are expected.





PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Patient Communications

• Answer and return patient phone calls with warmth, clarity, and professionalism

• Respond to patient
s and texts promptly and accurately

• Help patients with scheduling, questions, reminders, and follow up

• Communicate proactively with the Practice Manager and team regarding urgent items, missing information, and next steps



Insurance Payment Posting and Receipts

• Post insurance payments accurately

• Prepare and send patient receipts

• Flag discrepancies, underpayments, and missing payments with clear notes for the team



Data Entry and Records

• Enter patient, insurance, and office data accurately and completely

• Maintain organized spreadsheets, reports, logs, and administrative records



KPIs and Reporting

• Track and report practice KPIs such as call response time,
 and text response time, payment posting turnaround, receipts sent, and task completion rates

• Use data to highlight trends and opportunities for growth and a better patient experience



Auditing and Quality Control

• Audit that all work across the practice is completed accurately and on time

• Follow up on incomplete or overdue items until they are resolved

• Recommend and help implement process improvements

• Assist with other administrative projects as needed





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You must speak and write fluent English with a clear, neutral accent that sounds natural, polished, and professional to patients and United States based team members. Because this role is a voice of our practice, your voice recording is one of the most important parts of your application.



The right person is:



• Warm, gracious, and confident on the phone

• Highly organized and exceptionally detail oriented

• Accurate and efficient with data entry

• Experienced with insurance payment posting or medical billing (preferred)

• Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and able to keep records accurate and easy to review

• Proactive and anticipatory, able to identify an issue and suggest the next step without waiting to be told

• Systems minded, someone who notices when work is not completed and takes action

• Comfortable tracking metrics and using numbers to drive improvement

• Flexible and comfortable shifting priorities in a fast paced office

• Trustworthy, discreet, and respectful of confidential patient and financial information

• Reliable, responsive, and accountable for completing assignments on time

• Willing to learn optometry specific processes and systems



Experience with a United States medical, optometry, ophthalmology, or dental office is strongly preferred. Experience with OfficeMate, ExamWriter, VSP, EyeMed, Medicare, or other US insurance carriers is a plus, but not required.





TO APPLY



Please submit all of the following to 



1. A brief introduction explaining your relevant patient communication and insurance or data entry experience

2. Your resume

3. A short voice recording introducing yourself in English, answering this question: "A patient calls upset that their bill is higher than expected. How would you respond?"

4. Your desired monthly salary in Philippine pesos

5. Your internet speed test results

6. One KPI you have tracked in a previous role and how it helped improve results



Include the words "See Better, Live Brighter" in the subject line of your application so we know you read the full posting.



Applications sent through the OnlineJobs.ph message system alone, without the items above, will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long term role and takes pride in making an office run better every day.

 is fine) introducing yourself and describing how you handled a customer who was late paying or a shipment that went wrong. Paste the link.



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed. Apply only through OnlineJobs.ph. Applications sent by
, phone or any other website will not be considered.

title: Hiring: Experienced YouTube Bodycam Video Editor | Long-Form Crime & Police Footage
description:
Hiring: Experienced YouTube Bodycam Video Editor | Long-Form Crime & Police Footage



We are looking for a skilled, creative video editor for a YouTube channel focused on real police bodycam footage, high-intensity encounters, unusual arrests, pursuits, and compelling law enforcement incidents.



Our goal is to transform raw police footage into engaging, professionally edited videos that keep viewers watching from beginning to end.



Editing Style Reference: Midwest Safety (YouTube)



Please review videos from the YouTube channel Midwest Safety before applying.



We are looking for a similar standard of editing, particularly:



- Strong opening hooks: Capture attention within the first 15–30 seconds using the most compelling moments of the incident.

- Excellent pacing: Remove unnecessary downtime, repetitive dialogue, uneventful driving, and lengthy pauses without sacrificing important context.

- Compelling storytelling: Present events in a logical, engaging sequence that builds curiosity and anticipation.

- Clean, professional editing: Use effective cuts, strategic zoom-ins, camera transitions, and well-timed visual emphasis.

- Clear audio and subtitles: Make police dialogue, suspect interactions, and radio communications easy to follow.

- Informative on-screen context: Introduce relevant background information, incident details, and case outcomes when supported by reliable sources.



We want the same level of viewer engagement and professionalism while developing our own recognizable channel identity.



What You Will Do



1. Transform Raw Bodycam Footage into Engaging Videos



- Edit raw police bodycam and dashcam recordings into compelling 15–25-minute YouTube videos, depending on the available footage.

- Identify the most interesting moments and structure the video around them.

- Eliminate unnecessary footage while preserving important dialogue and events.

- Create strong introductions, smooth transitions, and satisfying conclusions.



2. Build Suspense and Maintain Viewer Retention



- Use strategic cuts, camera zooms, subtle sound effects, and music where appropriate.

- Build anticipation around pursuits, confrontations, escapes, arrests, and unexpected developments.

- Maintain natural tension without excessive effects or misleading editing.



3. Professional Audio Editing



- Improve unclear dialogue where technically possible.

- Balance police radios, dispatch communications, environmental sounds, and conversations.

- Reduce distracting background noise.

- Incorporate subtle background music and sound design without overpowering the original footage.



4. Subtitles, Graphics & Context



- Add accurate, easy-to-read subtitles during important conversations.

- Highlight key statements and relevant details.

- Incorporate professional text overlays, timelines, maps, or case information where useful.

- Clearly distinguish verified facts from allegations or disputed claims.



5. YouTube Compliance & Quality Control



- Apply appropriate blurring to sensitive footage, personal information, minors, and graphic content.

- Understand YouTube's advertiser-friendly content guidelines.

- Avoid unnecessary graphic imagery, misleading effects, and sensationalized representations.

- Deliver polished videos ready for YouTube publication.



Requirements



- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos, preferably police bodycam, true crime, or investigative content.

- Strong understanding of YouTube audience retention and storytelling.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable professional editing software.

- Excellent English comprehension, including fast conversations, accents, police terminology, and difficult audio.

- Strong audio editing, captioning, and visual storytelling skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.

- Excellent attention to detail and factual accuracy.



 Project Details



- Video length: Approximately 15–25 minutes, depending on the incident.

- Content provided: Original bodycam/dashcam footage and available case information.

- Work: Ongoing opportunities for the right editor.

- Compensation: Please provide your rate per completed video.

- Turnaround: Please indicate your typical delivery time.



How to Apply — Read Carefully



To confirm that you have read this posting, begin your application with the exact phrase:



SAFETY RIDE



Please include:



1. Links to 2–3 examples of your best relevant editing work.

2. Your experience editing bodycam, crime, or documentary-style YouTube content.

3. Your price for a completed 15–25-minute video.

4. Your typical turnaround time.

5. The editing software you use.

6. A brief explanation of how you would approach editing a video in the style of Midwest Safety.



Applications without relevant portfolio examples or the required opening phrase may not be considered.



We are looking for a reliable editor interested in building a long-term working relationship as the channel grows.

title: US Outbound Phone Closer – Home Security Sales | $10–$15/hr + Uncapped Commission | Full-Time, Start ASAP
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Prairie & Palm is hiring for one of our US clients, a fast-growing home security company in Texas that is an authorized dealer of a major national home security brand. They need 2 full-time phone sales reps who can start right away.



This is NOT a VA or customer support role. You will be closing sales over the phone with US homeowners. If you have hit your numbers on a US outbound sales account (home services, telco, solar, insurance or similar), keep reading.



WHAT THE JOB LOOKS LIKE



- You call people who just bought a newly built home. Their home builder has already told them a local security provider will be reaching out, so you are expected.



- You ask a few questions to understand what matters to them, then present a promotion with no upfront cost.



- Most sales close on the first call: collect their details, send the agreement by DocuSign, and a technician installs within a day or two.



- The technician handles any extra equipment on site. Your job is to get the YES.



- You log every call, note and follow-up in the CRM.



- Leads are plentiful. You will not be hunting for lists.



SCHEDULE



- Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Central Time

- = 11:00 PM – 8:00 AM Philippine Time (10:00 PM – 7:00 AM PHT during US daylight saving time, March–November)



- Full-time, 40 hours/week, long-term



PAY



- $10 – $15 USD per hour base, based on experience

- PLUS uncapped commission on every sale you close

- Paid training and ongoing coaching



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must have:



- 3+ years in a quota-carrying role closing sales over the phone with US customers (B2C / residential preferred). Customer service, retention or appointment-setting alone does not count.

- Proven record of hitting or beating sales targets (be ready to share your numbers)

- Excellent spoken English: clear, natural and confident with American homeowners

- Resilience: you know a "no" is not personal, and you keep dialing

- Competitive, coachable, and motivated by earning more when you perform

- Quiet dedicated workspace, noise-canceling USB headset, reliable internet PLUS backup internet and power

- Able to work the full US Central Time schedule above



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "NEW KEYS". We will not review applications without it.



Nice to have:

- Home security, smart home, solar, telco or home-services sales experience

- CRM and DocuSign experience

- Conversational Spanish



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the keyword mentioned above, followed by your full name.

2. Attach your resume as a PDF. If you can't attach a file, include a link to it (Google Drive, Dropbox or similar), set so anyone with the link can view.

3. In your message, tell us:

   - How many years of US phone sales experience you have, and what you sold

   - Your typical monthly results compared with your target

   - Your current work-from-home setup (headset, internet, backup)

4. Record a 60–90 second VIDEO introduction (camera on). Briefly cover:

   - Your US phone sales experience: what you sold, and to whom

   - Your best sales result or achievement you're proud of

   - Why you'd be a great fit for this role



Upload it to Google Drive, Loom or YouTube (unlisted), set it so anyone with the link can view, and paste the link in your application.



Applications missing the resume or video will not be considered. We review applications daily and are hiring fast.

title: Experienced Creative Strategist for a Beauty & Supplement E-Commerce
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Creative Strategist with a strong background in DTC/e-commerce, especially within beauty, skincare, and supplement brands.



This is a performance-focused role. We’re not only looking for someone who can create good-looking ads, but we want someone who understands what makes creatives spend, scale, and generate profitable ROAS.



What You’ll Do

- Develop fresh creative concepts and angles for our beauty and supplement products.

- Create video and static ad concepts for Meta.

- Write hooks, scripts, headlines, ad copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Research competitors, customer reviews, trends, winning ads, and new opportunities.

- Develop concepts for different personas and stages of awareness.

- Analyze Spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and other creative performance metrics.

- Identify winning creatives and develop iterations to help them scale.

- Work closely with our media buyers, editors, and designers.

- Ensure ad messaging and creative angles align with our landing/product pages.

- Understand how to communicate beauty and supplement benefits while keeping claims appropriate.



Who We’re Looking For

You must have previous experience as a Creative Strategist for DTC/e-commerce brands.



Experience with beauty/skincare and supplements is highly preferred.



You should understand:

- Meta/Facebook advertising

- Direct-response creative strategy

- UGC and static advertising

- Creative testing and iteration

- Customer psychology and market awareness

- Performance metrics, particularly spend and ROAS



⚠️ IMPORTANT: PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT



Please do not apply without providing proof of previous creative performance.



Before we consider an application, you MUST attach a portfolio containing examples of ads/creatives you personally strategized.



For each relevant creative, please provide:

AD/CREATIVE

→ Your involvement/role

→ Total Ad Spend

→ ROAS

→ Other relevant results (CPA, CTR, purchases, etc., if available)

→ Proof of performance (screenshots from Meta Ads Manager or another verifiable source)



The Spend metric is especially important to us.



We want to see creatives that didn't simply achieve a strong ROAS on a small test budget; we want to understand how much spend the creative was able to handle while maintaining performance.



Applications that provide creative examples without Spend +, ROAS +, or supporting proof may not be considered.



Let us also know your hourly rate.

title: Content Manager & Video Editor — Short-Form Reels
description:
Type: Full-time, long-term remote role

Focus: Storytelling, video editing, voice-note breakdown, and scheduling



We are a husband and wife creating content about family life, parenthood, personal growth, leadership, business, and the projects we do together. We are looking for an editor who can find the stories in our recordings and turn them into videos that feel real, useful, and engaging.



We will provide raw footage, talking-head recordings, family videos, photos, voice notes, podcast clips, and ideas. You will review the material, identify strong stories, edit videos, write captions, organize the production queue, and schedule approved content.



Production target

Our target is 10 unique short-form Reels per production week, or 40 finished videos per month. Videos will generally be 30–120 seconds long.



Some videos may be quick moments from family footage; others may use a talking-head story with supporting B-roll. Each needs a clear story and an edit that fits it.



Posting one finished video on multiple platforms still counts as one video. Voice-note breakdown, captions, organization, and scheduling are part of the role; they are not additional video quotas.



What you will do

* Review uploaded footage and recordings to find strong moments, stories, quotes, and usable B-roll.

* Edit videos with effective openings, clear pacing, clean audio, accurate on-screen captions, and purposeful visuals.

* Listen to voice notes and identify the main message, strongest lines, possible hooks, story structure, and video opportunities.

* Turn promising voice notes into simple recording guidance: what we should say on camera and what footage would support it.

* Write a social caption, title, and appropriate call to action for each finished video.

* Organize raw footage, voice notes, working files, completed videos, and content saved for future use.

* Maintain a production calendar showing what is being edited, awaiting approval, approved, scheduled, and published.

* Schedule approved videos across the appropriate platforms and confirm they publish correctly.

* Give us a brief weekly update on completed videos, upcoming content, useful footage you found, and anything you need us to record.



Our footage may include cooking, raising chickens, gardening, home projects, family experiences, business conversations, and lessons from our lives. We will give direction on sensitive family topics and approve content before it is published.



What we are looking for

You should be able to watch a long recording and recognize the moment worth sharing. You understand when a video needs a quick pace and when a genuine moment needs room to breathe. You can use B-roll to strengthen a story and write captions that sound like people.



You should have:

* Strong short-form video editing skills and a portfolio to show them.

* Experience editing talking-head footage and selecting relevant B-roll.

* The ability to find several video opportunities in a longer recording or event.

* Clear written English for captions aimed at a U.S. audience.

* Strong file organization, scheduling, and deadline management.

* Reliable communication, internet, and editing equipment.

* Comfort using AI for transcription, organizing ideas, or drafting, while reviewing the final work yourself.



Experience with family, lifestyle, creator, podcast, or documentary-style content is a plus.



How to apply

Begin your application with FAMILY CONTENT. Then send:



1. A short introduction and your usual working hours and time zone.

2. Links to three videos you personally edited, including at least one talking-head video with B-roll. Briefly explain your role in each.

3. The editing, scheduling, transcription, and AI tools you use.

4. One example of how you found multiple video ideas within a longer recording or activity.

5. Your answer to this scenario: We send you family cooking footage and a seven-minute voice note about why making memories with our children matters. What three Reels would you suggest first? For each, give us the main idea and opening hook.



Selected finalists will be invited to complete a paid editing test using footage we provide. We will evaluate story selection, editing, captions, organization, communication, and how well you understand our style.



We want someone who can grow with us and build a reliable process for producing 40 thoughtful videos each month.

title: Influencer Research Assistant (Instagram/TikTok)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We run GO Companion, a mobile app for Pokémon GO players. We're looking for a reliable part-time VA to research and vet social media creators on Instagram and TikTok who might be a good fit to promote the app. You won't be writing posts or negotiating. You'll find creators, check them against a clear checklist, and log the results in a shared, pre-formatted Google Sheet.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Find Pokémon GO gaming creators on Instagram and TikTok.

- Check each creator's average views across their last 10 to 15 posts (ignoring the highest and lowest, and excluding pinned posts).

- Note: Follower count is not an important factor. Focus mainly on average view counts.

- Check that engagement looks real (genuine comments, not bots or giveaway spam).

- Confirm the content is consistently about Pokémon GO and not occasional gaming.

- Record their handle, profile link, follower count, average views, contact method (business
 and/or DM only), and a pass or fail with a one-line reason.

- Work about 10 to 15 hours per week, with steady output.



REQUIREMENTS

- Daily Instagram and TikTok user who understands what real engagement looks like.

- Strong written English.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets.

- Attention to detail. We'll check your work, and we'll give feedback quickly.

- Reliable internet and consistent availability.



PAY AND TRIAL

$3.15/hour. We start with a paid one-week trial, then move to ongoing work if it goes well.



TO APPLY

Please answer all of these in your application, or we won't consider it.

1. Start your reply with the words "Poké Ball" so we know you read this.

2. Tell us your experience with influencer or social media research, in 2 to 3 sentences.

3. How many hours a week can you work, and what's your timezone?

4. Do you play Pokémon GO or follow the community? (Not required, but helpful.)

5. Mini test: Find ONE Pokémon GO creator on Instagram or TikTok who averages roughly 5k to 50k views per video. Send us:

- Their handle and profile link

- Their average views over their last 10 posts (tell us how you calculated it)

- Two sentences on why they're a good fit, or one red flag you checked for (for example, fake-looking comments)

title: AI Video Creator & Motion Editor (Higgsfield / Generative AI)
description:
Location: Remote / Tampa, FL



Job Type: Contract / Project-Based (with potential for ongoing campaign work)



Compensation: Competitive Project Rate / Hourly (DOE)



About the Role

Tribeca Atelier is seeking a skilled AI Video Creator and Post-Production Editor to help produce a serialized, animated commercial campaign promoting our upcoming flagship cosmetology academy.



We are developing a narrative episodic story centered on character development, salon craftsmanship, and high-end visual style. The visual benchmark blends a 2.5D painterly, gouache/oil illustrative aesthetic (reminiscent of Arcane) with dynamic, cinematic direction.



You will translate storyboard prompts and visual assets into consistent video scenes using generative AI motion platforms—specifically Higgsfield—and assemble them into polished, sound-designed marketing assets across digital and social formats.



Key Responsibilities

Generative Motion & Video Synthesis: Direct, generate, and iterate motion shots using Higgsfield (leveraging character training models, camera control, and reference-guided generation) to achieve smooth, expressive movement without uncanny distortions.



Character & Aesthetic Consistency: Maintain strict visual and character model continuity across multi-scene narrative arcs based on established 2D/2.5D visual keys.



Editing & Post-Production: Cut, sequence, and pace scenes inside Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro; assemble multi-chapter vignettes tailored for web and short-form vertical video (9:16 and 16:9).



AI Cleanup & Inpainting: Perform frame interpolation, inpainting, cleanup, upscaling (e.g., Topaz), and stabilization to resolve common AI motion artifacts or limb inconsistencies.



Sound Design & Finishing: Integrate voiceover tracks, custom ambient Foley (salon sounds, urban ambiance), royalty-free cinematic scoring, and typography/motion graphics for titles and calls to action.



What We Are Looking For

Demonstrated AI Video Fluency: Hands-on experience executing end-to-end clips using Higgsfield (alongside platforms like Midjourney, Runway Gen-3, or Luma Dream Machine) with an understanding of seed consistency, camera prompts, and character anchors.



Strong Traditional Filmmaking & Editing Fundamentals: Deep knowledge of pacing, blocking, focal lengths, match cuts, and color grading.



Stylistic Eye: Ability to steer and preserve stylized, painterly aesthetics (avoiding generic "glossy 3D CGI" or synthetic stock appearances).



Portfolio / Reel Required: A reel demonstrating generative AI motion clips integrated with sound design, continuity across multiple cuts, and clean frame-to-frame movement.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with character training/LoRAs or fine-tuned model workflows.



Familiarity with beauty, fashion, editorial hair styling, or design-forward brand storytelling.



Proficiency in After Effects for motion graphics, title sequences, and subtle visual compositing.



How to Apply

Please submit your portfolio or showreel highlighting:



Examples of AI-generated video workflows where character or stylistic consistency is maintained across multiple cuts.



An outline of your primary toolstack (specifying your experience with Higgsfield).



Your standard project turnaround time and contract/hourly rates.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Clipper: Turn Real Estate Podcasts Into Viral Reels, Shorts & TikToks
description:
We're a content and marketing agency that turns long-form real estate investing content (podcasts, interviews, YouTube videos, webinars) into short-form clips that go viral and bring in leads. We're hiring one full-time clipper who will become a core part of the team.

This is not a basic editing job. We don't need someone who just cuts out the "ums." We need someone who can watch a 60-minute episode, find the 30 seconds that will stop someone mid-scroll, and rebuild that moment into a clip people watch to the end.

What you'll do every day

• Watch full long-form videos (30 to 120+ minutes) and find every moment worth clipping: bold claims, numbers, stories, hot takes, "aha" lines

• Deliver as many clips as the video truly supports. There is no quota: every clip must be well-rounded, add real value and stand on its own

• Cut every pause, stutter, filler word, false start and second of dead air. Clips must be fast-paced and tight from start to finish

• Reverse-engineer each clip: move the strongest line to the front as the hook, cut the slow parts, rearrange pieces so the story lands, end on a payoff or CTA

• Edit vertical (9:16) with captions, punch-in zooms, B-roll and sound design that keep the pace up without looking cheap

• Do all clipping by hand. We do not use Opus Clip or any AI auto-clipping tool

• Create visual on-screen hooks when asked. We want to see your creativity here

• Study viral clips in our niche, track what performs, and bring new ideas every week

You must have

• 1+ year clipping or repurposing long-form into short-form (podcast, interview or talking-head content)

• A portfolio with links to real posted clips and their view counts

• 100% manual editing skills: you find the moments and make the cuts yourself, no AI auto-clipping

• Fast, precise cleanup: you remove stutters, filler and dead air quickly without cuts feeling jumpy

• A strong grasp of short-form structure: hook in the first 1 to 3 seconds, value, pacing, retention, payoff, CTA

• Working knowledge of real estate investing (rentals, flips, BRRRR, wholesaling, cash flow, cap rate, creative finance), or the drive to learn it fast. You need to know which moment is valuable to an investor

• Premiere Pro, CapCut (desktop) or DaVinci Resolve

• Excellent written English and comprehension of fast spoken American English

• Reliable internet and a backup power plan

• Available 40 hrs/week with 3 to 4 hours overlapping US Eastern time

Big plus

• You've clipped for a podcast or creator with 100K+ followers

• You've had clips pass 1M views

• A strong eye for visual hooks: on-screen text, motion and framing that grab attention

• You can explain why a clip went viral, not just that it did

What we offer

• $5/hr, full-time, long-term

• Monthly performance bonus tied to views and retention, plus a bonus for any clip over 100K views

• Raises at 3 and 6 months based on results

• Path to Lead Editor as the agency grows

• Clear feedback and a team that cares about making great content

How to apply

Start your proposal with the word HOOKFIRST so we know you read this. Then answer the screening questions. Proposals without links to posted clips will not be reviewed. Every shortlisted applicant completes a paid sample edit before we hire. It's how we see if you're the right fit.

THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE



You're our Patient Setter. Your #1 job: move every new lead from the "New Lead" column in Go High Level to a booked call with Dr. Arneka. Then make sure they show up.



Can't reach them? You run our follow-up process: 3 ways in 3 days. Call, text, and
. Leads don't sit in "New Lead." Not on your watch.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY



• Respond to every new lead in under 5 minutes during your shift (Monday–Friday, 9 AM – 5 PM PT). Fast wins.

• Call and text every new lead to start the conversation and book their call with Dr. Arneka.

• Move every lead through the Go High Level pipeline, from "New Lead" to "Booked Call." Your goal is to keep that New Lead column empty.

• Follow up using our 3x3 process: 3 ways (call, text,
) over 3 days. We give you the process and the scripts. You run it on every lead, every time.

• Confirm every scheduled appointment by text the morning of, a couple hours before.

• Re-book no-shows and cancellations the same day.

• Log every touch in Go High Level: calls, texts, outcomes, notes. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.

• Send a short end-of-day report in Slack: leads contacted, calls booked, confirmations made, no-shows.

• Show up to a weekly team check-in to review your numbers and sharpen your scripts.

• Build and improve in Go High Level: workflows, automations, and landing pages. You'll use AI tools like Claude and/or Atlas to build faster and make your own job easier.



HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED



These are your KPIs for the first 90 days. Hit them and you grow with us:



• Speed to lead: Every new lead contacted in under 5 minutes during business hours

• Follow-up completion: Every lead you can't reach gets the full 3-ways-in-3-days follow-up

• Booking rate: % of reached leads who book a Discovery Call

• Show rate: % of booked appointments that actually show up

• CRM accuracy: Every lead logged, every time



MUST HAVE



• Fluent, clear spoken English. You'll be on the phone with patients in California all day.

• Comfortable on the phone. You actually like calling people. Cold, warm, follow-ups. None of it scares you.

• Comfortable texting and talking with patients all day. Warm, clear, and confident in writing and on the phone. You're a patient setter, not a robot.

• Familiar with Go High Level. You know pipelines, conversations, and calendars, and you're ready to learn workflows and landing pages. Everything we do lives in GHL.

• Familiar with AI tools like Claude and/or Atlas. You already use them (or are eager to) to write, build pages, and troubleshoot faster.

• Fast response habits. You keep Go High Level open and respond to new leads in under 5 minutes, every time.

• Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM – 5 PM Pacific Time (that's 1 AM – 9 AM Philippine time)

• Your own computer and phone, a quality headset, and a quiet work space. No background noise on calls.

• Team player who commits. You show up on time, you do what you say, and you tell us early if something's off.



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience as an appointment setter, SDR, or inside sales rep

• Experience building Go High Level workflows, funnels, or landing pages

• Experience in healthcare, chiropractic, physical therapy, or wellness

• Experience using Slack



WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GO



Right now, this role is 100% patient setting: new lead → booked call with Dr. Arneka.



The first 90 days are a trial. We track your KPIs and see how we work together. Hit your numbers and you grow with us: more responsibility, more pay, and the chance to move into taking Discovery Calls yourself on a base + commission model.



COMPENSATION



• $450/month flat fee

• 90-day trial tied to your KPIs. Hit them, and we move forward long-term.

• Full training, scripts, and systems provided. You won't be guessing.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



We want someone who follows instructions. This is your first test.



To apply, send your resume with this exact subject line:



YOUR NAME - Patient Setter - RESILIENT



In your application, answer these 4 questions:



1. What experience do you have making outbound calls or setting appointments? Give a specific example.

2. What have you built or done in Go High Level? Workflows, pipelines, landing pages. Be specific.

3. How do you use AI tools like Claude or Atlas in your work? Give a real example.

4. Send a 60-second video introducing yourself. Include the link.



Applications without "RESILIENT" in the subject line or without the 60-second video will not be reviewed.

title: B2B Cold Caller & Sales Closer — Part-Time
description:
B2B Cold Caller & Sales Closer (Part-Time, Remote)



Company: Datkov Studio  

Location: Remote — Philippines  

Hours: 20 hours per week  

Compensation: ₱35,000 monthly base + 15% sales commission  

Payment Schedule: Fortnightly  

Initial Arrangement: 2-week paid trial, with the opportunity for ongoing part-time work



ABOUT DATKOV STUDIO:

Datkov Studio is an Australian commercial creative studio producing professional visual content for consumer-product brands.



We create product imagery, lifestyle visuals, advertising creatives and short-form videos that businesses can use across their websites, social media, product launches and marketing campaigns.



Our services are completely done-for-you, from creative direction through to final delivery.



We're a growing, founder-led studio looking for an experienced salesperson to help us acquire clients across Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a confident and experienced B2B cold caller who can independently manage sales conversations and close deals.



Your primary responsibility will be contacting businesses from qualified lead lists provided by Datkov Studio, introducing our services, identifying potential opportunities and converting interested prospects into paying clients.



This is not an appointment-setting-only position. We're looking for someone capable of handling the full sales process, from the initial phone call through to closing.



You will not be responsible for researching businesses, sourcing phone numbers or generating lead lists. All leads and contact information will be provided.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Make outbound cold calls to business leads provided by Datkov Studio.

- Speak professionally with business owners, founders and marketing decision-makers.

- Introduce our commercial creative services and explain how they can benefit potential customers.

- Identify customer needs, marketing objectives and potential opportunities.

- Handle questions, objections and sales conversations confidently.

- Conduct discovery and sales meetings when necessary.

- Recommend appropriate creative packages based on customer requirements.

- Follow up with interested prospects and maintain professional relationships.

- Close sales and guide customers through our official payment process.

- Record call outcomes, prospect information and follow-up activities in our Notion CRM.

- Provide clear project handovers to the studio once a client has paid.

- Provide regular updates on sales activity and progress.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Required:



- Previous experience in B2B cold calling and outbound sales.

- Demonstrated experience closing deals, rather than only booking appointments.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confidence speaking with international business owners and decision-makers.

- Strong communication, listening and objection-handling skills.

- Ability to communicate professionally without relying entirely on scripts.

- Comfortable conducting sales conversations over the phone and through online meetings.

- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage follow-ups independently.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet environment suitable for professional calls.



Preferred:



- Experience selling creative, design, advertising or marketing services.

- Experience working with Australian, British or American clients.

- Familiarity with CRM software.

- Experience working remotely with small businesses or agencies.



You do not need previous experience with AI image or video production. We will provide information and training on our creative services, portfolio, packages and production process.



WHAT WE PROVIDE:

- Qualified business leads and phone numbers.

- Access to an international business calling platform.

- A Notion CRM for managing prospects and sales activity.

- A detailed sales playbook explaining our services, positioning, packages and sales process.

- Portfolio examples and approved sales materials.

- Direct communication with the studio founder.

- Guidance on creative capabilities, deliverables and pricing.



You will be responsible for selling our services, not producing the creative content.



COMPENSATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT:

- ₱35,000 monthly base compensation for 20 hours of work per week.

- 15% commission on eligible sales successfully closed and paid.

- Base compensation paid fortnightly.

- A paid two-week trial consisting of 20 total hours, with the applicable commission on eligible sales.

- Flexible working hours, with agreed availability during suitable calling periods for our target markets.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Opportunity for an ongoing part-time role following a successful trial.

- Compensation review after the initial three months, subject to performance and business circumstances.



Commission eligibility, payment timing, working arrangements and other terms will be clearly defined in a written agreement before work begins.



THE TWO-WEEK PAID TRIAL:

Selected candidates will complete a paid two-week (20 hours total) trial before an ongoing arrangement is offered.



During this period, you will:

- Learn about Datkov Studio's services, packages and portfolio.

- Review our sales playbook and familiarise yourself with our CRM.

- Demonstrate your ability to pitch our services professionally.

- Begin contacting qualified business leads provided by the studio.

- Handle prospect conversations, objections and follow-ups.

- Maintain accurate records of your sales activity.

- Demonstrate independence, professionalism and effective communication.



The trial will be evaluated based on communication, calling quality, sales ability, professionalism, reliability and the ability to advance genuine opportunities.



Closing a sale during the trial is welcome but is not a strict requirement for passing.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your previous sales experience.



2. Details of your B2B cold-calling experience, including the types of products or services you've sold.



3. An example of a deal you personally closed. Explain how you approached the prospect and secured the sale.



4. Whether you have experience speaking with Australian, UK or US businesses.



5. A 60–90-second voice introduction demonstrating your spoken English and explaining why you're interested in this role.



6. Your availability and preferred working schedule.



Please also answer this question:



"Imagine you're calling the owner of a skincare brand. How would you introduce Datkov Studio's commercial creative services and create interest in a potential project?"



We're particularly interested in candidates who understand how to communicate business value, build genuine relationships and close deals professionally.



ABOUT WORKING WITH US:

Datkov Studio is a growing creative business. This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder and play an important role in developing our client base.



We value clear communication, honesty, initiative, professionalism and a respectful working relationship.



We're looking for someone who can bring genuine sales expertise, take ownership of their conversations and grow alongside the studio as the business develops.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: B2B Sales Executive – U.S. Market | Remote | Base Salary + Uncapped Commission
description:
Green Freight Logistics LLC (GFL) is a U.S.-based freight brokerage and third-party logistics provider serving businesses throughout the United States.

We provide full truckload (FTL), less-than-truckload (LTL), dry van, refrigerated, flatbed, heavy-haul, specialized transportation, and drayage services.



As we expand our direct sales division, we are looking for ambitious, results-driven B2B sales professionals who have experience selling to U.S. businesses.



The Opportunity

We are looking for sales professionals who can win customers, not just book appointments.

You will be responsible for identifying U.S. businesses with freight transportation needs, connecting with decision-makers, developing relationships, and converting prospects into active, recurring shipping customers.

You will manage the commercial sales process from initial prospecting through customer acquisition and ongoing account development.

Our established operations and freight agent network handles carrier sourcing, shipment coordination, dispatch, tracking, and day-to-day transportation execution.

Your focus will be acquiring new business and growing customer relationships.

Previous logistics experience is an advantage but is not required for candidates with proven B2B sales success.



Key Responsibilities

Research and prospect U.S. manufacturers, distributors, importers, wholesalers, and other businesses that regularly ship freight.

Generate new business opportunities through cold calling,
 outreach, LinkedIn, and other approved sales channels.

Connect with logistics managers, shipping managers, transportation directors, procurement professionals, and business owners.

Identify customer shipping needs, transportation challenges, equipment requirements, and freight opportunities.

Present GFL's services and communicate the company's value proposition.

Secure qualified freight quote requests and convert opportunities into active shipping customers.

Work with the operations team to coordinate pricing, credit approvals, onboarding, and first shipments.

Develop customer relationships and generate repeat business.

Maintain accurate CRM records, follow-up schedules, and sales pipeline updates.

Achieve monthly targets for customer acquisition, qualified opportunities, and profitable freight revenue.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 2 years of outbound B2B sales experience, preferably selling to U.S.-based businesses.

Proven record of acquiring paying customers, not exclusively scheduling appointments.

Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication.

Strong cold-calling, prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, negotiation, and closing skills.

Comfortable speaking directly with U.S. decision-makers.

Experience managing a sales pipeline using a CRM system.

Strong organizational skills, persistence, and self-motivation.

Reliable internet connection and a professional remote workspace.

Availability during U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience selling freight brokerage, transportation, logistics, or 3PL services.

Background in B2B sales for manufacturing, industrial services, distribution, or supply chain companies.

Experience developing recurring commercial accounts.

Familiarity with the U.S. business environment.

Experience working remotely for a U.S.-based company.



What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this position if you consistently identify qualified prospects, develop meaningful relationships with U.S. shippers, secure new accounts, and grow recurring freight business.

We value measurable customer acquisition results over call volume alone.



How to Apply

Please submit your updated résumé and provide brief answers to the following:



How many years have you worked in outbound B2B sales targeting U.S. customers?

Have you personally closed new business and acquired paying customers? Describe your results.

What products or services have you sold, and what was your typical monthly sales quota?

What CRM systems have you used?

Are you available to work U.S. business hours?

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a live sales simulation to demonstrate their prospecting, communication, and objection-handling abilities.



Build relationships. Win customers. Grow with GFL.

title: Senior eCommerce Product Content Specialist / Management Trainee
description:
, a leading online retailer of office and commercial products based in Los Angeles, is expanding our eCommerce content team and looking for an experienced, highly organized, and self-motivated Senior eCommerce Product Content Specialist with management potential.



This is an opportunity for someone who wants more than just a data entry or product listing position. We are looking for a dependable professional who can independently manage responsibilities, take ownership of projects, solve problems, and eventually grow into a leadership or management position within our company.



In this role, you will oversee and execute product content research, development, optimization, and catalog management. Using AI tools, Excel, Magento, and other technologies, you will help maintain a high-quality product catalog that delivers an exceptional shopping experience and drives sales.



Unlike an entry-level content position, we expect you to work independently, exercise good judgment, identify opportunities for improvement, and take responsibility for the quality and completion of your work. You should be comfortable managing your own workload without constant supervision and be capable of helping train, guide, and coordinate other team members as you grow into the position.



Key Responsibilities



Product Research & Content Development

* Research and gather product specifications, descriptions, images, and other information from manufacturers and suppliers.

* Analyze, organize, and verify product information to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

* Create and improve product descriptions, specifications, titles, and other content to enhance the customer shopping experience.

* Manage and maintain product listings within our Magento eCommerce platform.

* Oversee product content updates, catalog organization, attributes, categories, and product information.

* Ensure product listings meet company standards for accuracy, formatting, quality, and consistency.

* Identify missing, inaccurate, or outdated product information and proactively resolve issues.

* Use AI tools effectively to research, organize, analyze, and improve product content.

* Review existing listings and identify opportunities to improve product presentation and content quality.

* Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, deadlines, and daily responsibilities.

* Take ownership of projects from beginning to completion, ensuring work is accurate and delivered on schedule.

* Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend ways to improve productivity and processes.

* Monitor work quality and ensure established standards and procedures are followed.



Leadership & Management Development

* Help coordinate and oversee product content projects and workflows.

* Assist with training, mentoring, and reviewing the work of other content team members.

* Communicate priorities, provide guidance, and help resolve day-to-day operational issues.

* Demonstrate the ability to make independent decisions and take responsibility for team and project results.

* Develop into a potential team lead or management role based on performance, reliability, and leadership ability.



Requirements

* Previous eCommerce Experience: Several years of hands-on experience managing product content, product catalogs, or eCommerce operations.

* Leadership Experience: Previous experience independently managing projects, workflows, people, or business operations. Supervisory or team leadership experience is a strong advantage.

* Magento Experience: Working knowledge of Magento or similar eCommerce platforms such as Shopify or BigCommerce.

* Advanced Excel Skills: Strong Excel knowledge, including formulas, data organization, filtering, sorting, and working with large product data files.

* Excellent English: Strong written and verbal English communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

* Basic Photoshop Skills: Ability to edit, resize, crop, and optimize product images.

* HTML Knowledge: Familiarity with basic HTML for editing and formatting product descriptions and website content.

* Problem-Solving Ability: Ability to research issues, find solutions, make sound decisions, and work independently.

* Strong Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain high-quality work.

* Accountability & Reliability: Someone who takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and can be trusted to work independently.

* Full-Time Availability: Ability to work 40 hours per week, with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with our Los Angeles business hours (8 AM–6 PM PST).

* Exclusivity: This is a full-time position requiring your professional commitment. Applicants must not have other jobs or conflicting employment commitments.



Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience supervising or managing a remote team.

* Experience with Magento 2, product imports/exports, bulk catalog updates, and product attribute management.

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, content development, and workflow automation.

* Knowledge of SEO, keyword research, and eCommerce conversion optimization.

* Experience with project management tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Trello, or Jira.

* Graphic design experience using Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator.

* Experience developing standard operating procedures (SOPs), improving workflows, and training team members.





Benefits & Perks

* Paid Time Off: 20 days of paid leave per year.

* Training & Development: Opportunities to learn new technologies, systems, and management skills.

* Career Advancement: Potential to grow into a team lead, supervisor, or management position based on performance.

* Long-Term Stability: An opportunity to build a stable, long-term career with an established U.S.-based eCommerce company.

* Supportive Work Environment: Join a friendly, collaborative team that values initiative, accountability, and professional growth.

Dispatcher

Job Overview:



The Dispatcher coordinates daily transportation operations to support safe, reliable, and on-time USPS mail deliveries. This position communicates with drivers, monitors routes, audits compliance records, and addresses safety concerns while working closely with supervisors and upper management.



Key Responsibilities:



Assign drivers, trucks, and trailers to scheduled routes and communicate trip instructions.

 Monitor departures, arrivals, and route progress using Samsara and Trax.

 Coordinate coverage for driver absences, equipment breakdowns, delays, and schedule changes.

 Communicate with drivers and USPS facilities regarding delivery status and service issues.

 Review drivers’ available hours of service before assigning routes.

 Audit hours-of-service (HOS) logs for violations, missing information, uncertified logs, and other discrepancies.

Follow up with drivers and escalate recurring or unresolved issues to management.

 Review Driver Vehicle Inspection Reports (DVIRs) for completion, inspection duration, and reported defects.

Coordinate with drivers and maintenance staff to address equipment issues and document follow-up.

 Review safety events in Samsara, communicate concerns to drivers and supervisors, and track required coaching or corrective action.

 Monitor Driver Qualification (DQ) renewal deadlines, including licenses, medical certificates, and other required documents. Notify drivers and upper management of upcoming renewals, follow up on outstanding items, and promptly report expired documents.

 Follow up on missing trailer numbers, shipping IDs, and other required trip information.

 Maintain accurate records of route assignments, delays, i
, compliance findings, and shift handoffs.

 Escalate a
, emergencies, missed trips, and unresolved safety or compliance issues promptly.

 Support company safety policies and transportation procedures.



Required Skills & Qualifications:



Previous dispatch, transportation, logistics, or fleet coordination experience preferred.

 Strong communication, organization, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

 Ability to prioritize tasks and remain calm in a fast-paced environment.

 Comfortable using computers,
, spreadsheets, and transportation software.

 Familiarity with Samsara, Trax, HOS requirements, DVIRs, and driver qualification records preferred.

 Reliable attendance and ability to work independently and with a team.

This position requires frequent computer and telephone use and communication with drivers throughout the shift. Depending on operational needs, the schedule may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.







Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Marketing & Social Media Manager | Full-time | Premium Home Builder
description:
Can you make a premium builder impossible to ignore, for the right clients? Build Prestige Homes is a design and construct builder of premium custom homes based in Brisbane, Australia, and we are looking for an expert Marketing & Social Media Manager.



We have award-winning residences, a strong reputation built since 2010, a new website and an audience of around 42,000 followers, but our marketing has not kept pace with our work. We have a strong, established brand. The directors have prepared our marketing strategy. Your role is to learn our brand, maintain it and protect it, review the strategy and suggest improvements, then execute it with expert care.



We work with a small number of high-end clients. We do not want hundreds of leads that do not suit us. We want a smaller number of quality enquiries from the right clients.



Above all, we want someone who takes work off the directors' plate and never adds to it. You will be proactive, solve problems, make sensible decisions within clear limits and bring solutions, not questions.



You will work closely with the director and the general manager, with the opportunity to grow alongside the business. This is a full-time independent contractor engagement of 40 hours per week, worked Monday to Friday, with flexible hours between 8:00am and 7:00pm Brisbane time (Australian Eastern Standard Time). All content, brand material, systems and data you create in the role belong to Build Prestige Homes.



Pay is USD $6.50 to $9.00 per hour, depending on experience, paid weekly via Wise.



We offer flexible working times, Philippine regular holidays off and paid (special non-working days are unpaid), your birthday off as a paid holiday (paid at your usual daily hours), training and support for your growth and development, the ability to grow with the team and working from home.



POSITION REQUIREMENTS

- At least 3 years of experience in digital marketing and social media management, including executing marketing strategies with measurable results

- Experience marketing premium or luxury brands, with examples of work that shows a high standard of quality

- Experience working within an established brand guide and protecting brand standards in writing, design and video

- A portfolio of social media accounts you have run, with examples of posts and the results they achieved

- Strong skills in Canva and short-form video editing for reels and stories

- Proven results in search engine optimisation (SEO) and local search

- Understanding of answer engine optimisation (AEO): how to make a business visible and accurately described in AI tools, including ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews

- Hands-on experience with WordPress, including page updates and on-page SEO

- Confident using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar), with the judgement to check and edit everything before it is used

- Excellent written English, with a high standard of grammar, spelling and consistency

- A proven record of taking work off a manager's plate: proactive, solution focused and able to work independently with minimal supervision

- Takes feedback well and repositions work quickly when it is not landing

- Reliable computer, stable internet connection and a suitable work environment



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Brand Protection

- Learn our Brand Voice Guide and brand standards in full within your first 2 weeks

- Review our existing content, website and social channels within your first 2 weeks and flag anything that does not meet our brand standards

- Apply our brand guide to every piece of work, with no exceptions, and keep our look, tone and messaging consistent across every channel

- Check every post, page,
 and video for accuracy, spelling, grammar and consistency before it is submitted

- Suggest improvements to our brand voice and our Claude skills, for approval by the directors



Marketing Strategy

- Review the 90 day marketing strategy prepared by the directors within your first 2 weeks, and give feedback on how it can be improved

- Execute the approved strategy with expert care

- Report what the results show and recommend changes to the strategy for the directors to approve

- Focus every activity on quality enquiries from clients building premium homes over $1.2 million in South East Queensland

- Work in 2 week cycles and adjust quickly when results or feedback show something is not working



Social Media & Content

- Run our Claude marketing skills to draft captions, articles, web pages and
s, then check and finish every piece before it is submitted

- Plan and run a content calendar across Instagram,
, Pinterest, LinkedIn and Houzz, posting regularly and on schedule

- Create posts, carousels, reels and stories from our library of residence and site photographs and video

- Draft and publish journal articles, suburb and service pages, residence case studies and campaign landing pages for approval

- Maintain our website, including page updates, on-page SEO and fixing errors

- Respond to comments and messages promptly

- Review and update our marketing collateral every six months, for approval by the directors

- Support marketing for Site Squared, as directed by the directors



SEO & AEO Visibility

- Make sure Build Prestige Homes is visible in Google search (SEO) and in AI answer engines, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Perplexity (AEO)

- Keep our website technically sound for search: page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, site speed and structured data (schema)

- Improve our Google rankings for high-intent local searches across our service areas

- Keep our Google Business Profile current, with regular posts and photographs

- Publish clear question-and-answer content and FAQ sections that answer engines can quote accurately

- Keep our business details identical everywhere they appear online, including directories and Houzz

- Check each month how Google and AI tools describe us, and fix anything wrong or missing



Enquiries & Referrals

- Record each new enquiry and pass genuine enquiries to the director and general manager the same day

- Run the follow-up and nurture
s for enquiries, for approval by the directors

- Support our referral program with building designers, real estate and buyers agents and other industry contacts



The Professional Builder Implementation

- Work through our business coaching lessons (The Professional Builder) for marketing and sales

- Turn each lesson into a working procedure, checklist, template or report, for approval by the directors

- Put each approved product into daily use

- Review our marketing standard operating procedures (SOPs) as you use them and recommend changes for approval

- As you settle in and show you are ready, take on more of the directors' tasks as agreed. The role is designed to grow



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

- Directors: every daily summary leaves the directors with nothing to do

- Brand: brand guide learned and content review delivered within the first 2 weeks

- Strategy: feedback on the strategy within the first 2 weeks, then the 90 day plan delivered on schedule

- Quality Enquiries: enquiries that match our ideal client and budget, tracked by source

- Social Media: content calendar delivered on schedule, with engagement growing

- Quality: work submitted to our brand guide and standard, with minimal corrections needed

- SEO and AEO: first page Google rankings and accurate AI answers for agreed priority searches, checked monthly

- Professional Builder: one approved product put into use every 2 weeks



MEETINGS & REPORTING



Daily Update

- Post a short summary in our WhatsApp group at the end of each day covering what was completed and what is next. The summary must not leave the directors with anything to do



Daily Decision Meeting (15 minutes)

- Meet with the director or general manager each working day for decisions only, so no work waits on them

- Bring each decision needed in a simple format: the problem, the options and your recommendation

- Keep the meeting to 15 minutes and action each decision the same day



Weekly Results Report

- Report each week on enquiries, content delivered, social results, search position and progress against the 90 day plan



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- Marketing for builders, building designers, interior designers, real estate or other premium home services

- Experience marketing to Australian clients

- Photography or video skills for content



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

To show you have read this advert in full, start your application with the phrase "Pizza is perfection". Applications without it will not be considered.



Please include a link to your portfolio: social media accounts you have run, with examples of posts and the results they achieved. Portfolios that do not show premium work will not be considered.



Please also submit a short video outlining:

- Why you are interested in the position

- How you would make us visible in Google and in AI answer engines

- How your experience aligns with the position requirements and key responsibilities

- A time you solved a problem for your manager without being asked

- One piece of work in your portfolio you are most proud of, and why

- Your desired income

- Areas where you may require further training

title: Product Render Artist – Lifestyle & Food Texture (CPG)
description:
Contract Product Render Artist – Lifestyle & Food Texture (CPG)

 

We're hiring a contract Product Render Artist to turn our packaging renders into premium lifestyle images for our website, ads,
, and social. You'll report to our Creative Lead, who writes the briefs and approves final work. You own the image making, from first concept to final export.

 

*ALL APPLICANTS MUST SHARE A PORTFOLIO OF PRODUCT OR LIFESTYLE IMAGES. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test using one of our bar renders. The test will include one lifestyle scene and one out-of-pack bar image.

 

This is a production role, not a strategy role. We give you finished packaging renders, artwork, and a clear brief. You make two kinds of images: lifestyle scenes built around our packaging, and realistic out-of-pack shots of the bar itself, unwrapped, half in the wrapper, or broken open to show what's inside. Every image should look premium, feel like our brand, and show the product exactly as it is.

 

We're starting with a launch batch for our new protein bar flavors, then moving to steady ongoing work.

 

How an image moves from brief to live

 

1. Our Creative Lead sends the brief, renders, artwork, and references.

2. You share concepts or rough comps.

3. We review together, and you revise until it's approved.

4. You deliver final files sized and exported for each placement.

 

What you'll do

 

Lifestyle and product images

 

• Turn our packaging renders into lifestyle scenes for product pages (PDP), paid ads,
, and organic social.

• Keep every label, logo, and line of text pixel-exact. No warped, redrawn, or AI-altered packaging.

• Build ingredient and detail images that make our real-food ingredients easy to see at a glance.

• Match light, shadow, perspective, and color so the product looks like it was really in the scene.

 

Out-of-pack bar images

 

• Create realistic images of the bar outside the wrapper: fully unwrapped, peeking out of a torn or opened wrapper, and broken or cut to show the inside.

• Match the real bar's texture, color, and surface detail for each flavor, including nuts, seeds, chocolate, and other visible ingredients.

• Build a reusable set of accurate bar textures for each flavor so new scenes stay consistent.

• Make close-up texture and cross-section shots that make the bar look like real food you want to eat.

 

Tools and workflow

 

• Use whatever mix of AI image tools, 3D, and Photoshop gets the best result for each image.

• Composite and retouch in Photoshop: shadows, reflections, color matching, and cleanup.

• Export every image in the sizes and crops we need for PDP, Meta ads,
, and social.

• Keep an organized library of source files, scenes, and finals so anything can be reused or updated.

 

Process

 

• Hit agreed turnaround times from brief to concept, and from approval to final files.

• Make variants for testing: different scenes, angles, crops, and backgrounds.

• Flag early when a brief, render, or deadline won't work.

 

What you bring

 

Must have

 

• 3+ years making product or lifestyle images for ecommerce or CPG brands, ideally food, beverage, or wellness.

• A portfolio of product images, with before and after or source files where you have them.

• Proven ability to make food look real and appetizing in renders or composites. Show at least one out-of-pack or food texture example in your portfolio.

• Expert in Photoshop compositing and retouching.

• Hands-on with AI image tools (Higgsfield, Nano Banana, Midjourney, Firefly, or similar), and knows how to keep packaging accurate when using them.

• Fast, reliable, and organized. You hit deadlines and communicate early when something slips.

• Takes feedback well and turns revisions around quickly.

 

Nice to have

 

• Working skill in 3D (Blender or Cinema 4D) for products, textures, and lighting.

• Experience building 3D packaging renders from dielines.

• Short motion or animated product content.

• Experience working within a brand refresh.

• Interest in real food, clean ingredients, or regenerative agriculture.

The Sidekick Crew is a growing Australian-based business providing virtual staffing and operational support to businesses across various industries.



We are looking for an experienced and highly organised **E-commerce Virtual Assistant** to support our client's growing e-commerce operations. The successful candidate will play an important role in managing day-to-day store operations, customer service, inventory coordination, and administrative tasks across multiple platforms.



This is an opportunity for someone who understands the end-to-end e-commerce process and can confidently manage different systems while maintaining excellent customer service.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. E-commerce Store Management

- Manage and maintain two Shopify storefronts, covering both Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) and Business-to-Business (B2B) operations.

- Process and monitor customer orders, ensuring accuracy and timely fulfilment.

- Update product listings, pricing, and inventory information.

- Monitor order status and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve fulfilment issues.

- Maintain accurate customer and product records.



### 2. Customer Service & Order Management

- Manage customer inquiries across multiple
 inboxes and communication channels.

- Respond to customer concerns professionally and promptly.

- Process returns, refunds, exchanges, and delivery address changes.

- Handle order-related concerns and coordinate resolutions with internal teams and third-party providers.

- Maintain a high standard of customer experience throughout the purchasing journey.



### 3. Inventory & Stock Management

- Manage inventory updates and stock reconciliation using Cin7.

- Monitor stock levels and identify discrepancies.

- Coordinate stock movements and inventory updates between Shopify and Cin7.

- Liaise with third-party logistics (3PL) providers regarding stock availability, dispatches, and fulfilment.

- Ensure inventory records are accurate and up to date.



### 4. Finance & Administrative Support

- Assist with Xero reconciliations and invoicing.

- Maintain accurate customer accounts and financial records.

- Support accounts administration and transaction tracking.

- Maintain stockist accounts and monitor agent commissions.

- Assist with general operational and administrative reporting.



### 5.
 Marketing & CRM Support

- Assist with
 marketing campaigns and customer communications.

- Support customer segmentation and
 list management.

- Help maintain and update marketing databases.

- Assist with campaign preparation and execution through Klaviyo.



## Required Qualifications & Experience



- At least 2 years of relevant experience in e-commerce operations or a similar role.

- Hands-on experience managing Shopify stores.

- Strong working knowledge of Cin7, particularly inventory management and stock reconciliation.

- Experience using Xero for invoicing, reconciliations, and financial administration.

- Previous experience handling customer service inquiries and order fulfilment.

- Experience coordinating with third-party logistics providers.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to multitask, prioritise workloads, and work independently.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience supporting Australian e-commerce or retail businesses.

- Experience managing both B2C and B2B operations.

- Familiarity with Klaviyo for
 marketing.

- Experience managing stockist accounts and agent commissions.

- Experience working with US-based e-commerce businesses is also welcome.



## Technical Requirements



Candidates should be comfortable working with the following platforms:



- Shopify

- Cin7 (strong preference)

- Xero

- Klaviyo (advantage)

- Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

-
 and customer communication platforms



## Ideal Candidate Profile



We are looking for someone who is:



- **Proactive:** Can identify operational issues and take initiative to resolve them.

- **Detail-oriented:** Understands the importance of accurate inventory, financial, and customer records.

- **Customer-focused:** Communicates professionally and knows how to handle customer concerns.

- **Tech-savvy:** Can navigate multiple software platforms and adapt to new systems.

- **Reliable:** Takes ownership of assigned tasks and consistently meets deadlines.

- **Organised:** Can manage multiple priorities without compromising work quality.



## Work Setup & Expectations
